rows.original:
There's so much treasure here! Where did it all come from? Or maybe not all of it, that kind of story would take ages.

        "Pfff, ages! As if. Most of this splendid shining wonder came from the same place. The minotaurs! The minotaur king knows my people are good at finding the riches he prefers, so he heaps bits of the finished works upon me as thanks! What kind of queen would I be to say no to gifts," she says. As she speaks, she lifts two great fistfuls of coins into the air and lets them shower down over her body. 
        
        "Some of it does come from elsewhere, but we try not to outright steal. Some of my little ones can be a little overzealous in their desire to please, though. No helping that. The rest comes from visitors who were ambushed by cave monsters. Whether they survive or not, they sometimes lose important gifts that were on the way to Khor'Minoan nobles. Some of those are the prettiest," she continues. Her hands caress a larger than life bronze statue of Lumia, sprouting a full, thick pair of bulls horns.
        
        Huh, so most of it comes from Khor'minos then? Has that changed between kings?
        
        "Between kings? They change them out? I have noticed just recently that there is less interest in our knowledge. The gifts I get come one at a time from thankful miners, rather than in bulk. Is this because of king switching? I hope they switch back soon. As much as I enjoy these gifts, it's more fun when there are a lot of them at once,"
        
        [flags.TODO_KM_QUEST|You know why the king had stopped trading trinkets, but there's no need to explain it all here.|You briefly wonder why the king has stopped trading trinkets to the kobolds. Maybe you can look into that at some point.]
rows.translation:
这里有这么多宝藏！它们都是从哪里来的呢？或者，也许并不是所有的宝藏都来自同一个地方……要解释清楚这样的故事，恐怕需要花上很长时间吧。

“哼，花很长时间啊！才不会呢。这些闪闪发光的珍宝，大部分都是来自同一个地方——弥诺陶洛斯！ 弥诺陶洛斯国王知道我的子民很擅长找到他想要的珍宝，所以他就把那些成品中的些许物品堆放在我面前作为感谢！她说：“我这样的王后，怎么会拒绝这样的礼物呢？”说着，她将两大把硬币举到空中，让它们纷纷落在了自己的身上。 
        
        其中一部分确实来自其他地方，但我们尽量不会直接抄袭。不过，我的那些孩子们有时候会过于热衷于讨好别人，这也无可奈何。剩下的那些礼物则是那些被洞穴怪物伏击的访客们留下的。无论他们是否幸存，有时候都会丢失一些原本是要送给科尔·米诺安贵族的重要礼物。其中一些礼物可真是漂亮极了，”她继续说道。她的双手部轻轻抚摸着那座比真人还要庞大的卢米娅青铜雕像——那雕像上长着一对粗壮的公牛角。
        
        哈，这么说来，这些东西大多都是来自科尔米诺斯的吧？在不同的国王统治期间，这种情况有变化吗？

“在不同的国王统治期间？他们会更换这些来源吗？我最近确实注意到，人们对我们的知识越来越不感兴趣了。我收到的礼物都是那些心怀感激的矿工们一次寄来的一件件，而不是成批送来的。这是因为国王更换了吗？我希望他们能尽快恢复原来的做法。虽然我很喜欢这些礼物，但当它们一次大批量地出现的时候，才真正有趣呢。
        
        [flags.TODO_KM_QUEST|你知道为什么国王停止了交易那些小饰品，但在这里没有必要把原因都解释清楚。|你不禁疑惑，为什么国王不再向地精们交易小饰品了。或许以后可以试着调查一下这个原因。]

"So[pc.isBimbo|...|, like,] who are all these kobolds?" you ask, indicating the small horde of regular sized kobolds that mill about the cavern. Some of them look similar to the ones who occasionally ambush you in the tunnels, with muted colors and simple clothing. Bite marks and evidence of chewing can be seen on some of their adornments, but most seem pleased just to have them. From a cursory glance, a large majority of these kobolds are male.

        "Oh yes! These young things are my wonderful harem! I'm told all exotic queens have them. Whenever a little one I fancy comes to me from another part of the caves, I offer him a place in my court. It takes an awful lot of effort to keep me full of new children these days, so I like having as much variety as possible. It's fun seeing them claw their way out of their eggs and seeing what all colors come out. Each one of them is special to me," she explains, sweeping several of the jingle-jangly kobolds into a hug all at once.         Huh. You'll have to think about it, but if that's something you're interested in it could be fun to try it out.

rows.original:
Does the queen have an actual name, or are you to just address her as 'queen' and nothing else?

        "Just queen is fine! I love the sound of it. All the surface royalty have their people call them the queen or the king, and my little ones love playing pretend as much as I love showering them with my riches," she chuckles.
        
        Well, that is one way to go about it, but even royalty have names. Queen so and so or king whatshisname. They aren't just blank slates. The gigantic kobold's eyes go wide.
        
        "O-oh. I had a name, once. Umm... what was it," she rubs her hands to her temples, brow furrowing and eyes completely closed. She suddenly turns, digging through her pile of treasure. She tosses aside precious metals, instead lifting up various gemstones and colorful rocks. She inspects each before letting it drop back to join the rest. 
        
        "No, no, not these. These are all wrong, it was bigger than th- ah! This!" She hefts a block of reddish smooth stone that's big enough to require two hands even for her. It's shot through with some darker bands of color, but mostly consistent otherwise.
        
        "Jasper! I think I still like just 'Queen' better, but that was what I was called before." 
        
        At least that's something interesting to know about her.

rows.original: Your eyes wander through the massive pile of gold and treasure that the Kobold Queen's been hoarding to herself. There's enough money here to buy a country – she could be more than just a queen of some kobolds living in some caves if she knew how to spend it. Well, and if she could get out in the first place. The caves might be too small for her. You lean down and pick up a fistful of coins, letting them flow off the side of your palms and between your fingers, trickling back onto the pile. You don't dare take any for yourself – you can feel the Kobold Queen's curious gaze boring into you from above, not threatening but ever wondering. Still, she doesn't stop you from touching the goods: as long as you don't try to pull a fast one, she seems okay with you being a little handsy. When you do it again, you notice something particular among the glints and gleams of the falling coins. Namely, the distinct lack of something shiny resting among the piles of coins. You rifle through the pile, seeking it out... and your fingers wrap around something long, solid, and thin, like a pipe. The coins part when you pull, revealing what looks to be an oil lamp of some sort. It has a fairly plain design: the handle is only large enough for your index finger, and the body is wide enough that you could squeeze the whole thing in your hand. It has a flared base to keep it steady when set on a flat surface; the spout has a slight curve upward, ending in an open point for a flame to wick from; and its cap, perhaps its most ornate feature, is a small disc with a number of ornamental carvings and etches strewn about its rim, with a simple, rusted chain going from it to the handle to keep it from getting misplaced. Adorned on top of the cap is a gemstone, but it's been crusted with dirt and mud, hiding whatever value it might truly have. All in all, it's not an impressive thing, and frankly, you wonder what it's doing in the Kobold Queen's stash. The lamp's crusted with dirt and it's been scratched and pockmarked with misuse and neglect. In a past life, it might have been described as 'shiny,' but now, you'd sooner find it in a trash pile than in a mountain of gold coins. Perhaps the metal it's made of just needs a bit of polish? Out of curiosity, you flip open the lid and peer inside – and, as expected, the most you find is more dust and caked mud. There isn't even a wick to feed into the oil. When you rub your thumb along its side to scrap off a bit of dirt, you feel something else: something etched directly into the metal. It's difficult to see exactly what it might be, though, especially in this light, and especially in the dirty condition the oil lamp is in. [pc.isBimbo |You've only been looking at this lamp for a few minutes, but you've already gotten so attached to it! You're probably the first friend it's had in years! You don't want to put it back into the pile; imagine how sad it'd be! |Honestly, fuck it: this thing's caught your interest. It's too unique an item in the Kobold Queen's pile, as dirty and forgotten as it is. If it's not worth anything, then at least it'd make for a good night light. ] You ask the Kobold Queen if she wouldn't mind if you had it. The queen scrunches her eyes, trying to see the comparatively tiny lamp you're holding in your hands. Her look changes from bubbly smiles to a bewildered frown as she focuses on it, and the pile of loot shakes as she rolls onto her belly to get a closer look. She hasn't given you an immediate 'no,' but it seems there's more to it. "Hold it a bit closer," she says, narrowing one eye when you oblige. "I don't remember this one! I know every bit of treasure my little ones have brought to the pile, but this one is new!" That's... odd? How could it have gotten here in that case? You let her take the lamp from you and usher some of the smaller kobolds over to look at it. None of them show any greater recollection of the lamp than she did, and if anything that only serves to bring the excited smile back to her face. You brace yourself as she plops right back onto the pile beside you. "Well if it's not mine, then it must have come to my pile for you!" She says, excitedly fiddling with the small lamp and clasping it between two claws. "I've never really gotten to be the one giving a treasure before. It feels kinda backwards, but if anyone should get something from me other than my little ones, I think you're the best choice!" She hands you back the oil lamp. When you hold it in your hands again, it somehow feels different now that you've been given permission to own it.
rows.translation: 你的目轻型在那一堆堆积如山的黄金和财宝上徘徊——这些都是狗头人女王多年来独自积攒下来的。这里的财富足以买下一个国家；如果她懂得如何使用这些钱，她就不会仅仅是一个生活在洞穴里的狗头人们的女王了。 嗯，前提是她能从那里逃出来才行。那些洞穴对她来说可能太小了。 你弯下腰，抓起一把硬币，让它们从手部掌边缘滑落，从指缝间落下，然后又重新落回到那堆硬币上。 你根本不敢私自拿走任何东西——你能感觉到那位狗头人女王那充满好奇的目轻型正从上方注视着你，那种目轻型并不带有威胁性，只是始终在疑惑着什么。不过，她并没有阻止你触碰那些货物：只要你不试图耍花招，她似乎并不介意你稍微动动手部。 当你再次做这个动作时，你会注意到那些掉落的钱币在闪烁轻型芒中有一些特别之处。也就是说，其中有一些明显的不同之处。 缺乏 在一堆堆硬币中，你发现了一件闪闪发轻型的东西。你仔细地翻找着，终于找到了它……你的手部指触到了一样长而结实、又很细的东西，看起来像一根管子。 当你拉动它的时候，那些硬币被拨开了，露出了一个看起来像是油灯的东西。 它的设计相当简洁：把手部的大小仅适合容纳你的食指，壶身则宽厚到可以整个握在手部中。壶底呈喇叭状，这样放在平面上时就能保持稳定；壶嘴略微向上弯曲，末端呈开口状，便于火焰从其中散发出来；而它的盖子，或许也是整个设计中最具装饰性的部分——那是一个小圆盘，边缘上分布着许多精美的雕刻和花纹，还有一条简单的、略带锈迹的链条将盖子与把手部连接在一起，防止盖子被弄丢。 帽顶上镶嵌着一颗宝石，但它已经被污垢和泥浆覆盖，从而掩盖了它可能拥有的真正价值。 总而言之，这东西实在算不上什么了不起的东西，说实话，你甚至会怀疑它究竟为什么会被放在狗头人女王的收藏箱里。这盏灯上积满了灰尘，由于被随意使用和疏于保养，上面还布满了划痕和凹痕。在过去的某个时候，它或许还能被形容为“轻型亮夺目”，但现在，你宁愿在垃圾堆里找到它，也不愿在堆积如山的金币中看到它。 也许制作它的金属只需要稍微打磨一下就可以了？出于好奇，你掀开了盖子往里面看了看——果然，里面除了更多的灰尘和结块的污垢之外，什么也没有。甚至连用来导入油的导管都没有。 当你用拇指沿着它的边缘摩擦，试图刮掉一些污垢时，你会感受到一些其他的东西：那些直接铭刻在金属表面的痕迹。不过，要清楚地看清这些痕迹究竟是什么，其实相当困难——尤其是在这样的轻型线条件下，更是在这盏油灯如此脏污的状态下。 [pc.isBimbo |你才看了这个灯几分钟，就已经对它产生了如此深厚的感情！它很可能还是第一次拥有这样的“朋友”吧。 多年你肯定不想把它再放回那堆东西里吧；想象一下，那该有多让人难过啊！ |说实话，管它呢：既然这个东西引起了你的兴趣，那它总归有它的价值。在狗头人女王的那些物品中，尽管它那么脏兮兮的、被遗忘了，但它确实是一件独一无二的物品。如果它毫无价值，至少也可以当作一个不错的夜灯使用吧。 ] 你询问狗头人女王，是否不介意你拿走这个物品。 女王眯起眼睛，试图看清你手部中拿着的那个相对较小的灯。当她仔细观察它时，她的表情从欢快的笑容变成了困惑的皱眉，而她身上堆着的战利品也在她翻身想要看得更清楚时微微晃动起来。 她并没有直接拒绝你，但看来其中还有别的原因。 “把它拿近一点看看，”当你照做后，她眯起一只眼睛说道，“我不记得有这个了！我记得我的孩子们把所有找到的宝贝都拿来了，但这个确实是新的！这……有点奇怪吧？那样的话，它是怎么来到这里的呢？你让她从你手部里拿走了那盏灯，还让一些体型较小的狗头人过来看看。但他们中没有人比她对那盏灯有更多的记忆，相反，这反而让她的脸上重新露出了兴奋的笑容。 当你看到她重新坐回到你旁边的那堆东西上时，你立刻做好了准备。 “嗯，如果这不是我的，那肯定是你掉到我的这堆东西里的了！”她兴奋地说着，一边用两只爪子抓着那盏小灯，一边摆弄着它。 我其实从来都没有真正成为过那个想要成为的人。 给予 这真是一份珍贵的礼物。虽然感觉有点反常，但如果除了我的孩子们之外，还有谁应该收到我的礼物的话，我想你才是最合适的人选！” 她将油灯递还给了你。当你再次握住它的时候，不知为何，你感觉…… 不同 现在你已经被允许拥有它了。

[flags.KOBOLDS_LYRIC |You keep your wits about you, in the event that you’re about to be tackled by some strangers in the tunnels... but you have a suspicion that you know what to expect. rows.original: "Hey, hang on, hold on!" you hear a voice say. And as you do, your pack begins to shift and shuffle, jostling back and forth as Lyric fights to find the opening to the bag. Although you’re kind of in the middle of something, you whip your bag off your back and set it down, pulling the mouth open so Lyric can pull [lyric.himHer]self free. Lyric is perhaps too quick to get out of the bag, and [lyric.heShe] stumbles on [lyric.hisHer] feet before steadying [lyric.himHer]self and facing the two kobolds in front of you. "Right, okay!" [lyric.heShe] says, raising [lyric.hisHer] open hands and waving [lyric.hisHer] palms at the other kobolds, trying to signal to them to calm down. "Right. So. What’s this I hear about offerings to the queen?" At first, the male kobold doesn’t respond. He squints his eyes and leans forward, scrutinizing Lyric’s every detail from his distance. "Who are you?" he asks eventually. "You look familiar." "I used to live in Undermountain," Lyric explains. "Um... I, uh... don’t, anymore." The male kobold takes one step forward, his other foot planted firmly on the ground. He keeps his knives up and ready, but his posture slowly relaxes as he investigates Lyric some more. "Are you Lyric?" he eventually asks. "A green kobold that used to live here – there’s only one kobold that fits that description." "Yep, that’s me," Lyric laughs, scratching at [lyric.hisHer] face and looking away abashedly. "Is she still mad?" "She’s probably forgotten all about it already," the blue kobold laughs. "She’s got a lot on her plate and she’s pretty easy-going anyway. A few offerings to add to her hoard is all it takes to get her to think about something else." "Although," a third voice, from behind you, says. You turn to face the other female kobold. "I don’t think she’s ever dealt with someone directly violating their own exile before." She scratches at her chin as she thinks about it. "I don’t know. You must have done something pretty bad to get her so riled up in the first place. I don’t think she’s ever exiled anyone before." "What did you do?" the first male asks. Lyric hesitates at the question, hooking [lyric.hisHer] right hand behind [lyric.hisHer] back and kicking at the dust beneath [lyric.hisHer] feet for a moment. "I...," [lyric.heShe] says quietly, "I ate some of her gold." "What?" he asks again. "I ate some of her gold," Lyric repeats, much louder. At that, all four of the kobolds reel in surprise, as if they had just stumbled across a dead body. "Whoa, no wonder she was so mad!" the first female says. "You not only took from her personal hoard without her permission... but you ate it?!" "Could you blame me?!" Lyric cries in response. "Gold was so rare where I came from, and to see a mountain of it, just sitting there? What else was I supposed to do? How was I supposed to know that someone had claimed it? You know how delicious gold is!" "We also know not to touch the queen’s personal stash without her permission," the orange kobold behind you laughs. "Look, we’re getting distracted," Lyric sighs, stomping [lyric.hisHer] foot in irritation. "You guys are mugging people for their metal so you can present it to the queen as offering, right?" "That’s about the long and short of it, yep," the male confirms, as if it were the most innocent thing to be admitting to. "Okay, first of all: don’t," [lyric.heShe] chides, leaning forward and wagging [lyric.hisHer] finger at the two kobolds in front of [lyric.himHer]. "We may be small, but we don’t need to be told that stealing is wrong." "Well, see," the female starts, "if we bring metal to the queen, then she rewards us. Digging our own metal out of the ground is really hard and time consuming, so... well, as far as we see it, yeah, stealing is pretty okay, if it means getting more metal to give her." "No! No, no, no!" Lyric shouts. "How would you like it if we stole your knives, huh? Or the very rags off your backs? How would you like it if we took stuff that belonged to you?" All four of the kobolds pause before answering. "Is the metal going back to the queen?" the female behind you asks. "It doesn’t matter where it’s going; what’s important is that it’s not yours anymore. We’d be taking something of yours that doesn’t belong to us." None of them answer. Lyric sighs in frustration. "No, it wouldn’t be going to the queen." "Well, then, that’s bad." "But what else are we supposed to do?" asks the second male. "Besides, you know, working for it. We considered that and we don’t really want to do that." "Well, I have an idea about that, actually," Lyric says with an upward lilt in [lyric.hisHer] voice. [lyric.HeShe] steps towards you, hooking [lyric.hisHer] right arm around your waist and leaning against you, as if you two are the center attractions for a presentation. "Most foreigners like my [pc.race] here carry pouches full of metal that’s been cut into small discs." [lyric.HisHer] fingers find your electrum pouch, hanging dutifully off your hip. [var0 |Somehow, throughout all of your travels, and all of the encounters you’ve gone through, you haven’t kept a single electrum coin to your name. Without any electrum to further [lyric.hisHer] case, Lyric stands there beside you, awkwardly cupping your empty coin purse. None of the other four kobolds say anything. One of them coughs. "We should have an orgy," one of the females suggests. "Yeah!" Lyric says jovially, and suddenly, [lyric.hisHer] fingers are at the belt of your [pc.lowerGarments] instead. "Let’s do that instead!" |You are immediately concerned with the fact that Lyric is about to flaunt and offer your money to a group of kobolds that were just trying to mug you. "We know about that," the first male says. "We usually take the bigger stuff, like their weapons or tools or armor, if we can help it. They’re much bigger." "Ah, but here’s the thing," Lyric snickers. "These little discs have economic value on the surface. [pc.Race]s like my [pc.name] use them to buy stuff from other people." "We know that, too," the second female continues, crossing her arms. "Can’t imagine why, though. We literally pull bigger chunks of better, tastier stuff out of the ground every day." "See, I didn’t get it either," [lyric.heShe] laughs, looking over [lyric.hisHer] shoulder to speak to the other female. "But it kind of makes sense, if you think about it. [lyric.heShe] continues, "have you ever considered just bartering these people you mug for their little metal discs? [pc.Race]s will buy just about anything!" "No, we haven’t," the first male admits with a shrug, "but even if we did, we don’t have anything to barter with. We’re wearing rags and the only thing we own are these knives, like you said. [lyric.HeShe] leans forward, [lyric.hisHer] tongue sticking out from the corner of [lyric.hisHer] mouth mischievously. "You could offer yourselves." "What?" the male behind you asks. "What?" you ask. "They need to barter for it?" "Some of them don’t have mates?" the female in front of you asks. "Does yours have one?" [lyric.heShe] says through [lyric.hisHer] nervous laughter – although you can feel [lyric.himHer] squeezing [lyric.hisHer] arm tightly around your waist, holding you closer to [lyric.himHer]. "The point, the point that I’m making, that point, the point is, people on the surface are willing to just give you their little metal discs if you offer to have sex with them. You don’t need to mug them or rob them! Just offer to, you know, give them some affection, and they’ll hand it out like candy!" You wonder if this is really a healthy thing that Lyric is trying to do. On the one hand, [lyric.heShe]’s turning them into a troupe of sex workers who probably won’t understand the value of their own bodies – but on the other hand, they’re currently burglars, and sex work is legitimate and inarguably a step in the better direction. The two kobolds in front of you whisper to each other for a moment, keeping their voices low enough that they can’t carry to your ears. After just a few sentences, the [pc.mascFem |female |male ] kobold turns to you, then, sheathing [pc.mascFem |her knives, she |his knives, he ] sidles up to you slyly. "Your name is [pc.name], right?" [pc.mascFem |she |he ] says. You hesitate to confirm. "Ever had your [pc.hasRealCock |dick sucked |box eaten out ] by four kobolds before?" Before you have a chance to respond, you’re being accosted on all sides by what were once your muggers, each of them vying for your sexual attention. You were about to fight, weren’t you? All four of them had their weapons drawn, and now they’re fighting over each other to sexually satisfy you because Lyric’s put it in their head that you’ll pay them for it. Which... well. You might as well. It’d be rude if you didn’t. "Hey!" Lyric snaps, stepping in between you and the two kobolds in front of you. "Let’s get two things straight here!" The two kobolds stop their approach, waiting for Lyric to continue. "First, when you give the electrum discs to the queen...." Immediately, [lyric.hisHer] fierce, vociferous demeanor turns meek and apprehensive. "Could you tell her that it was from me? I’m kinda hoping that she’ll forgive me if I can give her some offerings, but I can’t exactly, you know, do it myself. I’m afraid of what she’ll do to me if I try." The orange one pauses to think about it, but the blue one answers quickly. "Sure, if we can remember," she answers. "Thank you," Lyric says, [lyric.hisHer] tail wagging behind [lyric.himHer] with the news. "And second: I’m not going to let some wild, strange kobolds touch my [pc.race] without my supervision. This isn’t happening unless I’m a part of it! I know what [pc.heShe] likes anyway, and you wouldn’t get anywhere close to satisfying [pc.himHer] without me." "Will you be taking a cut of the discs?" the male one behind you asks. Lyric shrugs. "That's up to [pc.name]," [lyric.heShe] says, looking up at you with a warm, innocent smile and a twinkle in [lyric.hisHer] eye. Just minutes ago, you were ready to defend yourself from a quartet of kobold muggers, and now, each of them are sexually soliciting you for your cash. And if getting into an orgy with four different kobolds wasn’t crazy enough, you’re going to have to deal with Lyric on top of all of that. You suppose you'll have to worry about their 'rates' later. ]

The male kobold takes one step forward, his other foot planted firmly on the ground. He keeps his knives up and ready, but his posture slowly relaxes as he investigates Lyric some more. "You not only took from her personal hoard without her permission... but you ate it?!" "Could you blame me?!" Lyric cries in response. All four of the kobolds pause before answering. "Is the metal going back to the queen?" the female behind you asks. "No, it wouldn’t be going to the queen." "Well, then, that’s bad." "But what else are we supposed to do?" asks the second male. "Besides, you know, working for it. rows.original: That's odd. You're pretty sure that this side tunnel isn't meant to be part of the usual tunnel network — instead of the hewn and smoothed passageways the minotaurs have left over the generations of hollowing out the undermountain, this looks rough around the edges and is coated with speckles of dark volcanic glass. In fact, it looks relatively new... and from the scorch marks all over the place, wasn't carved by hands. [party.hasCompanions |Holding up a hand for [party.compNames] to hold |Cautiously ], you examine the edges of the passageway and still find them warm to the touch. Well, if this isn't some kind of providence, especially after what Mai told you about magma golems and the elemental core she wanted. While there's no guarantee that this is what you're looking for, it's a better bet than wandering about the bowels of this mountain searching blindly. Of course, if this is a lead to your quarry, then you'd better be prepared — it's not likely that you're going to get another shot at this. With that said, are you ready to confront a magma golem? You've no doubt seen the numerous rock constructs that prowl the twisting tunnels in this mountain; no doubt this is a somewhat similar case, although one can reasonably expect a burning rock creature to be a bit more of a challenge as opposed to a plain old rock creature. Some preparation might be in order in the spirit of avoiding a sticky situation, especially when you've only one shot at taking down your quarry.

rows.original: It doesn't seem like you've any more excuses to drag this out any further. Carefully, you start pacing down the length of the newly-molten tunnel, [party.hasCompanions |[party.compNames] trailing behind you |your steps crunching softly on slivers of obsidian ]. The air of apprehension only grows with the temperature and sulfurous stench all about you; thankfully, while it gets uncomfortable to breathe, at least things don't get to the point where you're outright suffocating for want of actual air. But eventually you come upon your quarry — a vaguely human-shaped mass of molten rock in a sweltering chamber of its own making. Heat rises off it, causing the air to shimmer, and as you watch it presses itself against the far wall of the room, slowly melting a path through the mountain like acid slowly eating through metal. Molten magma slowly drips from its body and puddles in its footsteps, the magical creature absorbing the material it mines through its body and leaving bits of itself in its wake. To be honest, the magma golem doesn't look too different from the earthen elementals that you've seen plying the undermountain's tunnels, only much hotter and a lot less solid. While not outright amorphous like a slime would be, this thing still manages to dribble and splash all over the place, no doubt the cause of the trail of cooling obsidian it's leaving in its wake. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona agni |"I actually feel kind of sorry for it," Cait muses as you close the distance. "Here it is, minding its own business and doing its own thing, and we're just going to pull up and — well, I'm not quite sure if it quite counts as alive. But still." Hey, the same could be said of any predator taking prey. "I know, I know. We do what we need to because we must." Cait hefts her [cait.weapon]. "Let's just get this over with, shall we?" |"Oh, it's one of these," Brint remarks, more to himself than anyone else. "You hear the Legion talk of these crawling up from way beneath the city every decade or two. Didn't think I'd wind up facing one myself." And how does the legion deal with them? "Usually by redirecting an aqueduct into the tunnels they melt and waiting for the steam to clear. Ugly business all around, but at least no one gets put into harm's way." Well, you don't have an aqueduct at hand, and you certainly don't have a legion, either. You fight your battles with the army you have, and at the moment that includes Brint. And to be perfectly honest, you'd rather have him than a legion. |"Oh, it's one of these," Brienne remarks, more to herself than anyone else. "You hear the Legion talk of these crawling up from way beneath the city every decade or two. Didn't think I'd wind up facing one myself." And how does the legion deal with them? "Usually by redirecting an aqueduct into the tunnels they melt and waiting for the steam to clear. Ugly business all around, but at least no one gets put into harm's way." Well, you don't have an aqueduct at hand, and you certainly don't have a legion, either. You fight your battles with the army you have, and at the moment that includes Brienne. And to be perfectly honest, you'd rather have her than a legion. |"Oh. Well." To your surprise, Arona looks a little disappointed at the prospect — although whether it's at her enemy or at herself is anyone's guess. "It's one of these situations again. Not sure how much use I can be, but a fight's a fight, right?" |"Now that's one ugly bastard," Agni muses as she looks up at the magma golem, the phoenix completely unbothered by the heat wafting off it. "I guess it can't help looking like what it is, because if I were in its shoes I certainly would choose to be more pleasant on the eyes. Like me." You can only shake your head and force a smile as you draw ever closer to your quarry. ] Engrossed as it is in its task, the magma golem doesn't notice you until you're almost upon it — or maybe it doesn't care until it's just about too late. When it does react, though, it's with a fluid alacrity that's absent in its rocky kin, bringing a molten fist down where you were standing a moment ago and splattering droplets of magma in all directions. A couple land on your [pc.armor], and you hurriedly pat them out before they have a chance to catch and seriously sear your clothing; by the time you're ready, the magma golem has already wheeled upon you and raised what passes for its fists defensively. Well, nothing for it. It's a fight!

rows.original:
Shaking your head, you step away from the obsidian-encrusted tunnel. While there's something to be said for tracking down one's quarry while the trail is still hot — literally so in this case — you're not sure if you're going to be able to make good of the opportunity just yet. Best to come back later when you're more prepared to face down a big hunk of molten rock.
        
        [party.randComp cait brint brienne kiyoko atugia arona agni azyrran quintillus
            |"Hey, there's no shame in coming back later," Cait quips as you back away from the warm tunnel and rejoin her. "It's not as if you're running away from the problem, just coming back when you've got the tools at hand."
            |"Best to be cautious," Brint says with a nod as you back away from the tunnel entrance and rejoin the party. "Even when I was a kid, I'd hear stories from the neighbors about prospectors were lost to living piles of rock — don't want to end up like them."
            |"Best to be cautious," Brienne says with a nod as you back away from the tunnel entrance and rejoin the party. "Even when I was a kid, I'd hear stories from the neighbors about prospectors were lost to living piles of rock — don't want to end up like them."
            |"Stepping back, beloved?" Kiyoko says, a finger on her lips. "What was that Macahn saying again — 'know yourself and know your enemy, and you can enter a hundred battles and always emerge victorious?' Something like that or the other, I do not remember the exact wording. Ah, we can always come back when we are more prepared, not to worry; no one will think less of you for it."
            |"Ain't no shame in stepping back for a bit," Atugia says as you back away from the tunnel and rejoin her. "Carmen always said that picking and choosing your battles was important to winning. Fight smarter, not harder and all that. We'll be back when you're ready."
            |"Heading back already?" Arona taps her [arona.weapon] impatiently as you back away from the tunnel entrance to rejoin her. "And here I was itching for a fight... although I can understand why you'd do so."
            
            You're surprised that she isn't just plain mad you're advancing backwards, as it were.
            
            "No need to get cheeky. Back in the islands, Hretha and Infrith would give us blessings before we'd fight such creatures, give our weapons just that bit more oomph. Magical creatures aren't ghosts, but it doesn't hurt to have a couple tricks up your own sleeve in case they pull off some kind of magical bullshit. You ever seen a water elemental shatter in a shower of blobs when your hammer should've gone straight through it?"
            
            Yeah, she gets it. You need to be a tad more prepared, and you'll be back before the trail gets cold.
            
            "Sure, sure."
            |"Heading back?" Agni says, raising an eyebrow as you back away from the tunnel and rejoin her. "You looked enthusiastic enough to begin with. What made you change your mind?"
            Well, given that other people only have one shot at this life thing you can't afford to be as cavalier with it as she is. That and while a big hunk of burning rock might not pose that much of a threat to her, you're rather more vulnerable to having your extremities burnt off.
            
            "I'm old enough to have heard every excuse in the book, and as excuses go it's actually a reasonable one. Eight out of ten," she chuckles. "Seriously though, I do get it. Watching you make your preparations will be interesting — it'll be a chance to get to know your priorities better, if nothing else."
            |"We're not heading in there yet?" Azyrran says as you back away from the tunnel and head back to the party. "Phew."
            
            She sounds more concerned about the prospect than you are. The heat getting to her?
            
            "Not so much the heat in and of itself as the fact that I think I smelled smoke coming from down there, the thick, sulfurous kind. Normal wood smoke's bad enough, but..." she makes a face. "I can only imagine what noxious fumes rising out of molten rock will be like. You may laugh at the idea of someone struggling to stay awake while in combat, but it's an actual problem not just for us vesperans, but also the bees. Don't worry about it — take as long as you need to prepare. I know I will." 
            |"Getting cold feet?" Quin quips as you back away from the tunnel and head back to the party. "It's fine to have second thoughts on the matter."
            
            You're not retreating for good, you're merely taking a step back and considering your options before you make a move.
            
            "Good idea. Second chances are pretty hard to come by, so you ought to make the first go good." He claps you on the shoulder. "What, you thought I was going to tease you for it. Not today, not today. Come on, let's get moving, time's a-wasting."

rows.translation:
你摇摇头，走出了那条覆盖着黑曜石的隧道。虽然在这个情况下，趁痕迹还清晰时去追踪目标确实是个不错的选择，但你还不确定自己是否能够把握这个机会。最好等自己准备得更充分一些，再回来面对那块熔岩吧。
        
        [party.randComp cait brint brienne kiyoko atugia arona agni azyrran quintillus
            |嘿，回来得晚一点也没什么可羞愧的，”当你从温暖的隧道中走出来，重新回到她身边时，凯特开玩笑地说道，“又不是你在逃避问题，只是等准备好了应对方法之后才回来罢了。
            |最好还是谨慎一些，”布林特点头说道，这时你已经从隧道入口处退了回来，重新加入了队伍。“即使在我还是个孩子的时候，也经常听到邻居们讲那些探矿者是如何被堆积如山的岩石困住而无法脱身的——我们可不想落得同样的下场。
            |最好还是谨慎一些，”布蕾妮点头说道。当你从隧道入口退回来，重新加入队伍时，她继续说道：“即使在我还是个孩子的时候，也经常听到邻居们讲那些探矿者是如何被堆积如山的岩石困住而失踪的——我们可不想落得同样的下场。
            |先退一步吧，亲爱的？”清子用手指轻按着嘴唇说道，“那个马卡恩之前说过什么来着——‘知己知彼，百战不殆’，大概是这个意思吧，具体说法我记不太清了。啊，等我们准备得更充分的时候再回来也不迟，别担心，没人会因此看轻你的。
            |暂时退一步并没有什么可羞愧的，”当你从隧道中退出，重新与她会合时，阿图吉娅说道。“卡门总是说过，明智地选择战斗的对象才是获胜的关键。要聪明地战斗，而不是盲目地硬拼。等你准备好了，我们就会回来。
            |就已经要回去了吗？”阿罗娜轻敲着她的肩膀说道。 [arona.weapon] 你急切地后退，离开隧道入口，想要重新与她会合。“我就等着跟你打架呢……虽然我也能理解你为什么会有这样的举动。”

你很惊讶，她并没有因为你这种后退的行为而大发雷霆。
            
            别这么嚣张。在那些岛屿上，赫蕾莎和Infrith会在我们与这样的生物战斗之前赐予我们祝福，让我们的武器更具威力。魔法生物虽然不是鬼魂，但准备一些应对措施总没有坏处，以防它们使出什么魔法诡计。 你有没有见过，本该一锤子就能击穿的水元素生物，却会在被击中后分裂成无数小水滴散开？”

“是啊，她明白这个意思。你得更加做好准备，这样就能在那些残余物冷却之前再次行动了。
            
            当然，当然。
            |要回去吗？”阿格尼挑了挑眉毛，当你从隧道里走出来重新回到她身边时问道，“你一开始看起来可挺热情的啊，是什么让你改变了主意呢？”

嗯，毕竟别人只有一次机会来体验这次人生，你可不能像她那样随意对待它。 而且，虽然一大块燃烧的岩石对她来说可能并不会构成太大的威胁，但你的四肢被烧伤的话，就真的会面临严重的危险了。

“我年纪大了，听过各种各样的借口，而就这些借口来说，这个确实算是一个合理的。 十有八九吧，”她轻笑道，“说真的，我理解你的感受。看着你做各种准备，应该会很有意思——至少能让我更清楚地了解你的优先事项。
            |我们还没进去吗？”当你从隧道中退出，回到队伍中时，阿兹兰问道，“呼……”

她听起来比你还要担心这个情况。是热浪让她感到不适吗？
            
            倒不是说那股热气本身有多可怕，而是我觉得我闻到了从下面传来的烟雾——那种浓重的、带有硫磺味的烟雾。普通的木头燃烧产生的烟雾已经很糟糕了，但是……”她做了个鬼脸，“我实在无法想象从熔岩中散发出来的有毒气体会有多可怕。 你可能会觉得，在战斗中有人努力保持清醒这个想法很可笑，但事实上，这确实是一个问题——不仅对我们这些“黄昏战士”来说如此，对那些“蜜蜂”来说也是如此。别担心，你可以花尽可能多的时间来准备。我知道，我自己也会这么做的。" 
            |临阵退缩了？”当你从隧道中退出，准备回到派对现场时，Quin打趣道，“对此事产生疑虑也是正常的。”

你并不是要永远退出，只是想先退一步，仔细考虑一下自己的选择，然后再做决定。
            
            好主意。第二次机会其实很难得，所以你一定要第一次就做好。”他拍了拍你的肩膀。“怎么，你以为我会因此取笑你吗？今天不行，绝对不行。快，我们走吧，时间不等人了。"
        ]
rows.raw:
'
        Shaking your head, you step away from the obsidian-encrusted tunnel. While there's something to be said for tracking down one's quarry while the trail is still hot — literally so in this case — you're not sure if you're going to be able to make good of the opportunity just yet. Best to come back later when you're more prepared to face down a big hunk of molten rock.
        
        [party.randComp cait brint brienne kiyoko atugia arona agni azyrran quintillus
            |"Hey, there's no shame in coming back later," Cait quips as you back away from the warm tunnel and rejoin her. "It's not as if you're running away from the problem, just coming back when you've got the tools at hand."
            |"Best to be cautious," Brint says with a nod as you back away from the tunnel entrance and rejoin the party. "Even when I was a kid, I'd hear stories from the neighbors about prospectors were lost to living piles of rock — don't want to end up like them."
            |"Best to be cautious," Brienne says with a nod as you back away from the tunnel entrance and rejoin the party. "Even when I was a kid, I'd hear stories from the neighbors about prospectors were lost to living piles of rock — don't want to end up like them."
            |"Stepping back, beloved?" Kiyoko says, a finger on her lips. "What was that Macahn saying again — 'know yourself and know your enemy, and you can enter a hundred battles and always emerge victorious?' Something like that or the other, I do not remember the exact wording. Ah, we can always come back when we are more prepared, not to worry; no one will think less of you for it."
            |"Ain't no shame in stepping back for a bit," Atugia says as you back away from the tunnel and rejoin her. "Carmen always said that picking and choosing your battles was important to winning. Fight smarter, not harder and all that. We'll be back when you're ready."
            |"Heading back already?" Arona taps her [arona.weapon] impatiently as you back away from the tunnel entrance to rejoin her. "And here I was itching for a fight... although I can understand why you'd do so."
            
            You're surprised that she isn't just plain mad you're advancing backwards, as it were.
            
            "No need to get cheeky. Back in the islands, Hretha and Infrith would give us blessings before we'd fight such creatures, give our weapons just that bit more oomph. Magical creatures aren't ghosts, but it doesn't hurt to have a couple tricks up your own sleeve in case they pull off some kind of magical bullshit. You ever seen a water elemental shatter in a shower of blobs when your hammer should've gone straight through it?"
            
            Yeah, she gets it. You need to be a tad more prepared, and you'll be back before the trail gets cold.
            
            "Sure, sure."
            |"Heading back?" Agni says, raising an eyebrow as you back away from the tunnel and rejoin her. "You looked enthusiastic enough to begin with. What made you change your mind?"
            Well, given that other people only have one shot at this life thing you can't afford to be as cavalier with it as she is. That and while a big hunk of burning rock might not pose that much of a threat to her, you're rather more vulnerable to having your extremities burnt off.
            
            "I'm old enough to have heard every excuse in the book, and as excuses go it's actually a reasonable one. Eight out of ten," she chuckles. "Seriously though, I do get it. Watching you make your preparations will be interesting — it'll be a chance to get to know your priorities better, if nothing else."
            |"We're not heading in there yet?" Azyrran says as you back away from the tunnel and head back to the party. "Phew."
            
            She sounds more concerned about the prospect than you are. The heat getting to her?
            
            "Not so much the heat in and of itself as the fact that I think I smelled smoke coming from down there, the thick, sulfurous kind. Normal wood smoke's bad enough, but..." she makes a face. "I can only imagine what noxious fumes rising out of molten rock will be like. You may laugh at the idea of someone struggling to stay awake while in combat, but it's an actual problem not just for us vesperans, but also the bees. Don't worry about it — take as long as you need to prepare. I know I will." 
            |"Getting cold feet?" Quin quips as you back away from the tunnel and head back to the party. "It's fine to have second thoughts on the matter."
            
            You're not retreating for good, you're merely taking a step back and considering your options before you make a move.
            
            "Good idea. Second chances are pretty hard to come by, so you ought to make the first go good." He claps you on the shoulder. "What, you thought I was going to tease you for it. Not today, not today. Come on, let's get moving, time's a-wasting."
        ]

rows.original: As the final blow lands, nothing seems to happen at first. Then without warning, the magma golem loses consistency all at once, its humanoid shape falling apart into an amorphous heap of cooling slag and splashing droplets of magma in all directions as it settles. Wary of a ruse, you're hesitant to approach what remains of the golem, but seeing as it's rapidly cooling you don't really have much choice unless you want to chisel out the fire jade later. Thankfully, the gem isn't hard to find — it's actually lodged in a puddle that used to be the golem's left arm, the one that it was using to block your blows. Quite small by golem standards, too, which means it's about the size of your head; the bright orange-red color stands out against the sputtering mess it lies in, making it easily spottable. [party.has agni |"Want me to go in and get it?" Agni says, nudging you. "Doesn't look too hot for me to handle." Well, responsibility lies on you as the one who took on this job to get it yourself... "Oh, pish-posh. If you're going to say that, then I say responsibility falls upon the one who can actually wade into molten rock and pick the damned thing up without burning off her fingers. Wait here a moment and I'll be back with your shiny ball before you know it." You're about to reply, but Agni is already striding out firmly into the pool of molten rock, wading calf-deep into the mess before picking out the fire jade. Casual as ever, she holds it up and inspects it in the light, before blowing off a bit of residue and heading back to your side. "Here, catch. I've seen some trinkets in my time, and this isn't so bad all things considered." She thrusts the uncut gem into your arms — for something that was immersed in molten rock a minute or two ago, it's actually merely warm to the touch, if rather heavy for its size. Convenient that something so integral to a creature of fire and earth isn't searing your hands off, but you're not about to question your luck. Is she fine? She looks fine, but you ought to ask anyway. "Give me a moment to clean my feet — so long as none of that stuff cools on me, I should be fine. Frankly, it was kind of fun, like walking through treacle, but you don't want it sticking to you when you're done." |Now there's just the question of retrieving the gem. Gingerly, you reach out over the heat-shimmering air with your [pc.weapon] and give it a quick tap; when your weapon fails to burst into flame, you give it another prod and eventually feel confident in nudging it out of the magma puddle that the golem's now become. Despite having being recently immersed in the burning, viscous liquid, none of the lava remains stuck to the gem as you roll it out of the puddle, gritting your teeth against the terrible heat that rises from the golem's remains. Odd. The fire jade is an uncut lump as big as your head, and when you gingerly tap it only feels warm to the touch, as opposed to searing your finger off. It doesn't seem to retain or conduct heat very well at all, which is paradoxically at odds with the name it's been given. Convenient that something so integral to a creature of fire and earth can simply be picked and transported like this, but you're not about to question your luck. ] You turn over this so-called fire jade in your hands for a bit before finally stowing it away, since it doesn't look like it'll be setting fire to your other belongings anytime soon. Time to head back to Mai to turn this in and get your reward, then.
rows.translation: 当最后一击落下时，起初似乎什么都没有发生。然而，毫无征兆地，那团岩浆魔像突然失去了稳定性，它的人形结构瞬间崩解，化作了一堆无定形的冷却熔岩，同时还有熔岩液滴四处飞溅，最终落在地面。 你警惕着这可能是个陷阱，因此迟迟不敢靠近那具残余的魔像。但看到它正在迅速冷却，你实在没有其他选择，除非你想之后再费力地把那块火焰玉取出来。 幸运的是，这块宝石并不难找到——它实际上嵌在了一滩水里，而那滩水原本是魔像的左臂，正是它用那条手部臂来挡住你的攻击的。 按照魔像的标准来看，它的体积也相当小，大概只有你头那么大；那鲜艳的橙红色在它所处的那片杂乱环境中格外显眼，因此很容易被发现。 [party.has agni |要我进去拿吗？”阿格尼说着，轻轻推了推你，“看起来对我来说应该不是什么难事。” 嗯，毕竟这是你自告奋勇要来做的工作，责任自然就在你身上…… “哦，真是的。 如果你非得这么说的话，那我就认为，责任应该落在那个能够走进熔岩之中，捡起那个该死的东西而不会烫伤手指的人身上。你在这里稍等片刻，我马上就会把那个闪亮的球拿回来给你。就在你准备回应的时候，阿格尼已经大步走进了那片熔岩之中，脚没入熔岩中才有几厘米深，然后她在其中仔细寻找那块火玉。她依旧那么淡定自若，将找到的火玉举到光线下仔细检查，之后吹去上面的一些残留物，然后走回到了你的身边。 拿着，接住。这些年来我见过不少稀奇古怪的东西，不过相对来说，这个还算不错。” 她将那颗未经切割的宝石塞到你的手中——对于刚才还浸泡在熔岩中的东西来说，它的温度其实只是有点微热而已，而且相对于它的大小来说，它的重量也确实有点重。 真是太幸运了——对于这样一种与火与土紧密相连的生物来说，这种东西竟然不会烫伤你的手，你当然也不会去质疑自己的运气。 她没事吧？她…… 看起来 好吧，但你还是应该先问一下。 “给我一点时间把脚擦干净——只要那些东西没有弄到我的脚上，应该就不会有问题。说实话，这种感觉还挺有趣的，就像走在糖浆里一样，不过等走完之后，你可不想那些东西粘在身上啊。 |现在剩下的问题就是如何取到那颗宝石了。你小心翼翼地，伸出手去，穿过那片闪烁着热光的空气…… [pc.weapon] 轻轻敲击一下；如果你的武器没有燃烧起来，再敲一下，最终你就能熟练地将它从那些已经被变成熔岩池的魔像残骸中拨出来。尽管刚刚浸泡在那些灼热、粘稠的液体中，但当你把宝石从熔岩池中滚出来时，没有任何熔岩会粘在宝石上——尽管魔像残骸散发出的高温令你牙关紧闭，痛苦不堪。 奇怪，这块火焰玉是一块未加工的巨石，有你的头那么大。当你轻轻敲击它时，只会感觉到它摸起来很温暖，并不会烫伤手部指。看来它的导热性能并不好，这与它所获得的这个名字似乎有些矛盾。 对于这样一种与火与土紧密相连的生物来说，能够如此方便地将其摘下并携带，实在是一件非常幸运的事情。不过，你肯定不会去质疑自己的运气吧。 ] 你把手部里这个所谓的“火焰玉”翻来覆去地看了一会儿，最终还是把它收了起来——毕竟它看起来短期内并不会点燃你的其他物品。那么，是时候回到舞那里去交这个东西并领取奖励了。

rows.original:
Dripping molten bits of itself all over the tunnel, the magma golem casually picks you up with its molten fists and tosses you away from it like an insect — the impact of your landing knocks the breath from your lungs, [party.hasCompanions
        |followed by another "oof" as [party.compNames] land[party.oneCompanion
            |s
        ] atop you
        |leaving you dazed for several moments
    ]. You blink hurriedly, wondering what's going to happen next, but by all appearances the molten creature doesn't give chase. Instead, it turns its attention to the section of tunnel separating you and it, melting away the roof and walls to erect a wall of viscous molten rock; before long, it's sealed itself off from the rest of the tunnel network, the immense heat radiating from the magma as it cools and solidifies dissuading anyone from further pursuit. Guess the thing just wanted to be left alone... not that you didn't know that from the outset.
    
    But at length, the world stops spinning for long enough for you to get your bearings and shakily scramble to your feet. It's not just the heat that's soaking your [pc.armor] with sweat, but also heaviness in the air — you should probably take this chance to leave, because it's not certain that you'll get another if you linger too long. The plug of molten rock's already formed a crust over its surface as it cools, and your guess is that before too long there won't be any sign that this tunnel ever led anywhere.
    
    Well, you tried and failed. Good thing there're other options for you to get the fire gems you need... maybe you should've tried them to begin with instead of overstretching yourself like this. If the magma golem hadn't been so non-confrontational, things might've gone poorly for you.

        |紧接着又传来一声“哎哟”…… [party.compNames] 着陆[party.oneCompanion
            |s

rows.translation: 而且你也是。 [pc.name][party.som | |虽然如此…… [party.compNames] |而这些都是…… [party.compNames] ]很高兴见到你……能遇到一个不把自己关在墙后面、如此友善的人，真是太好了。” 你上下打量着这位身着蓝色服装的猫耳少女，现在情况已经平静了一些，你可以更仔细地观察她了。 虽然一眼就能看出她个子很高，但对于一个应该是猫族的人来说，这个高度已经算是异常高了——她的身高差不多有六英尺半，而她皮肤上那些旋转状的图案在洞穴顶部的昏暗轻型线以及发轻型的蘑菇所散发出的微弱轻型芒下，会微微闪烁着轻型芒。 但最重要的是，你会注意到，与普通的头发不同，尼哈拉的头发是由蓝色的、呈粘稠状的液体构成的——好吧，其实这种液体的粘性还不如水大，至少看起来是这样。从远处看，她的头发与真正的头发非常相似，甚至会让人误以为她是像猫族一样将头发染成了这种颜色，但现在你清楚地看到，这种天蓝色的头发完全是自然形成的。 她的尾巴也是同样的情况，她一共有两条尾巴。 [party.oneComp cait kiyoko |哦！”凯特惊呼道，眼睛瞪得大大的。“啊——”她用一种你听不懂的贾西兰语说出了某个词。尼哈拉也向你的同伴微微一笑，然后她们用贾西兰语简短地交谈了几句，之后才再次转向你。 他们见面后就能如此合得来，真是太好了。不过，如果他们不介意的话，能不能给那些不懂这种语言的人解释一下呢…… “对了，抱歉。尼哈拉其实是……我想在Belharan语中并没有一个完全对应的词，但用‘water wyrd’应该也能表达意思。 在贾西拉，它们可是非常有名的。因为现任苏丹娜的祖父在他的后宫里养了三只这样的动物；它们就生活在花园里的喷泉旁边。 |看到这一幕，清子挑了挑眉毛，然后不太掩饰地清了清嗓子。“啊…… 猫又一个被元素力量所眷顾的民族。” “什么？” “一个与贾西兰的猫人族非常相似的民族，他们起源于我的故乡马卡国对面的海峡另一边。实际上，他们几乎一模一样，唯一的区别就是他们有两条尾巴，而猫人族只有一条。有时候，他们当中会有人天生就被元素力量所眷顾，从而变成……在贝尔哈兰语中，我想最合适的称呼就是‘水之命运使徒’吧。 |她到底是什么人呢？ “嗯……我想在贝尔哈兰语中并没有一个准确的词汇来形容她，但‘水之精灵’应该是最接近的表述了。 ] 没错，用‘水之守护者’这个称呼已经足够贴切了，”尼哈拉点头表示同意，“我们就是这样称呼自己的——一个被原始元素力量所影响的人类。 [hellhound.met|没错。你回想一下在大地之火神庙遇到的那个地狱犬吧——那个原本可能拥有平凡血统的人，却因为某种原因被原始的元素力量所影响。想必尼哈拉也是这样的人……只不过她比那个地狱犬要文明得多，也学识渊博得多。|也许你应该感到惊讶，但在你迄今为止的旅途中，你已经见过一些更奇怪的事情了。对于你的认知来说，一只“黏液猫”应该算不上什么奇怪的东西吧。] — 那么，更重要的问题是：她为什么独自一人在这些隧道里？ “独自一人在这里？我住在这里。这就是我的家。” 实际上，这里也是许多人的家——毕竟有那么多被废弃的别墅，还有那些为了满足富人的需求而在湖边建立起来的小城镇。但由于隧道里到处都是害虫，所有人都躲在了科尔米诺斯的城墙之内。 我……我不能。我必须住在靠近水的地方，否则我会干枯而死；而其他的提兰人则躲到了城市中心区的神殿里，我无法跟随他们。 那些弥诺陶洛斯肯定不会允许我住在他们的引水渠里吧。”尼哈拉忧心忡忡地环顾四周，抬头望向那布满“星星”的天花板，仿佛随时都担心会有更多的小妖精突然降下来。“不过，你说得对，长时间待在露天环境中确实很危险。 也许我们应该找个更安全的地方谈谈吧？我家离这里不是很远。” 既然你已经走到这一步了，那就不妨听她把话说完吧。那你就带路吧。
rows.raw: " And you're [pc.name][party.som | |, while this is [party.compNames] |, while these are [party.compNames] ]. "Pleased to meet you... it's nice to meet a friendly face who isn't holed up behind walls." You look the azure catgirl up and down, and now that the situation's calmed down a bit you're able to take her in with greater detail. While you could tell at a glance that she was tall, she's unusually so for someone who's presumably a catfolk — about just under six and a half feet, and the swirling patterns laid out upon her skin glimmer faintly in the dim light from the cavern ceiling and glowing mushrooms. But most of all, you note that instead of strands or locks, Nihara's hair is composed of blue tendrils of watery goo — well, less goo than water, at least so it appears. From a distance, it resembles the real thing enough to be mistaken as being dyed in the same fashion as catfolk do, but now you see that the azure color's all-natural. The same goes for her tails, of which there're two. [party.oneComp cait kiyoko |"Oh!" Cait exclaims, her eyes growing wide. "A — " she says a word in Jassiran you don't understand. Nihara gives your companion a small smile of her own, and they hold a brief conversation in Jassiran before turning back to you. It's nice that they've hit it off so well moments after meeting, but if they wouldn't mind cluing in someone who doesn't speak the language... "Right, sorry. Nihara's a... I don't think there's a exact word in Belharan for it, but water wyrd will do well enough. They're pretty famous back in Jassira because the current sultana's grandfather kept a trio of them in his harem; they lived in his gardens by the fountain." |Kiyoko raises an eyebrow at the sight, then clears her throat not-quite-discreetly. "Ah. A nekomata, and one touched by elemental powers at that." A what? "A people not too unlike Jassiran catfolk who originate from just across the straits from my homeland in the nation of Macah. Almost identical, in fact, save for their two tails as opposed to the catfolk's one. Sometimes, those amongst them are born touched by elemental power, turning them into... I think the closest words in Belharan would be to call her a water wyrd." |Just what is she? "Hmm... I don't think there's an exact word in Belharan, but a water wyrd would be the closest approximation." ] Right, you see. "Yes, a water wyrd would be descriptive enough," Nihara agrees with a nod. "It is what we call ourselves, as a people touched by primordial elemental power." [hellhound.met|Right. You think back to the hellhound you met back at the temple of terrestrial fire, person who once might've had more mundane ancestry but were touched by primordial, elemental forces one way or another. Presumably Nihara is someone akin to that — only a lot more civilized and erudite than the hellhound.|Perhaps you should be surprised, but you've seen stranger things in your travels thus far. A goo-cat shouldn't be that much of a stretch for your sensibilities] — the more important question, then, is what was she doing here in the tunnels all alone? "Doing? I live here. This is my home." It was also plenty of peoples' homes, given all the abandoned villas and the small townships that sprung up by the lakeside in order to supply the wealthy with all they wanted, but they've all taken refuge within the walls of Khor'minos given the infestation rampant in the tunnels. Why hasn't she followed them? "I... I can't. I have to live close to water, or else I'll dry out; while the rest of the Tirans took refuge at the pantheon in the city's main district, I couldn't follow them. It's not like the minotaurs would let me live in one of their aqueducts." Nihara looks about fretfully, looking upwards towards the "star"-studded ceiling as if expecting more imps to swoop down any moment. "You're right in that it's dangerous to remain out in the open for too long, though. Maybe we should find someplace safer to talk? My home's not too far away." In for a penny, in for a pound — you've come this far, so you might as well hear her out. Lead the way, then. "

rows.original:
As it turns out, several minutes later you're in a small lakeside home, a building propped up on stout stone pillars a good ways over the water. Half of the place used to be some kind of baths or a masseur's clinic of some sort, although it's clear that they haven't been used for some time now, and the remainder consists of Nihara's living quarters. It looks classy and vaguely foreign in a way that you can't quite place your finger on — Tronariian? Macahn? — but that's no doubt the kind of atmosphere an establishment would have wanted to foster, exotic enough to be novel, but familiar enough to make people feel comfortable. Nihara offers [party.hasCompanions
                |[party.combatNames] seats
                |you a seat
            ] at a glass table that could've come out of Tychris, and then pours you some water out of a pitcher.
            
            "I'm sorry, there's not much these days out here by the lake... but there's a lot of water to be had, if nothing else. Everyone who remains beyond the walls out of choice or necessity doesn't get to partake of what the minotaur king's ordered stockpiled, for obvious reasons.
            
            "Either way, thank you for saving me from those imps. I am rather in your debt, [pc.name]."
            
            Uh, sure. Could she get back to the topic at hand, though?
            
            "Certainly. What would you like to discuss?"
rows.translation:
几分钟后，你发现自己身处一座坐落在湖边的小屋中——这座建筑依靠坚固的石柱建在离水面相当远的地方。房子的一半区域曾经被用作浴场或按摩诊所，但显然已经有一段时间没有被人使用了；而剩下的部分则是尼原的居住区。 它看起来既高雅又带有一种难以名状的异国风情——是“Tronariian”风格呢，还是“Macahn”风格呢？但毫无疑问，这种氛围正是这类场所所希望营造的：既足够新奇独特，又能让人感到熟悉舒适。 尼原提供 [party.hasCompanions
                |[party.combatNames] 座位
                |请坐。
            ] 他坐在一张看起来就像是从提克里斯王国搬来的玻璃桌前，然后从水壶里给你倒了一些水。

“很抱歉，这些天湖边并没有什么食物……不过至少还有水喝。那些出于自愿或迫不得已而留在城墙之外的人，显然无法享受到弥诺陶洛斯国王下令储备的食物。

“不管怎样，谢谢你救了我，让我摆脱了那些小妖精的纠缠。我真的欠你一个人情。 [pc.name]嗯，当然可以。不过，她能回到正在讨论的主题上吗？”

“当然可以。您想讨论什么话题呢？

rows.original: However ill-advised as it might be to go wandering in the undermountain as it is right now, you can't leave someone in need to their own devices. Readying your [pc.weapon], you make a beeline for the scuffle at a jog, hoping to get the drop on the imps while their attention is still focused on the [pc.bg acolyte minstrel noblescion scholar |Tiran priestess |catfolk ]. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus kiyoko atugia etheryn |"Hurry!" Cait yells, breaking forward into a run. "It doesn't look good for her!" [pc.bg acolyte minstrel noblescion scholar |Interesting that Cait would be showing such concern for a Tiran priestess — aren't the two faiths in a bit of a friendly rivalry, as you understand religious politics at the moment? "Well, she's not a Tronariian, so it doesn't matter! That, and I wouldn't wish that on even my greatest enemy!" Not even Kasyrra or Tollus? "Well, they created the problem to begin with... but not the Tirans! Come on, [pc.name], we're almost on them!" |Ah, there goes Cait again, ever willing to help anyone in need. "Hey, you're the one who started it." Cait gives you a wink. "Or are you saying you're helping her only because she's got big tits and a nice ass?" [pc.cunningRange 65 |Exactly. Tits and ass — it's exactly why you picked Cait up off the ground that night, because she's got a huge pair on her for a kitten. |Hey! ] "All right, enough teasing you. Let's see what we can do about this, won't we?" ] |Brint doesn't say anything, but sets about making himself useful in short order — for someone so large, he can move quickly when he sets his mind to it. Checking one of the imps with his shoulder, your minotaur companion swats another away with his [brint.weapon], giving the azure kitty an opening to pick herself up again. |Brienne doesn't say anything, but sets about making herself useful in short order — for someone so large, she can move quickly when she sets her mind to it. Checking one of the imps with her shoulder, your cowgirl companion swats another away with her [brienne.weapon], giving the azure kitty an opening to pick herself up again. |Seeing you dash forward, Arona hesitates a bit, turning her gaze between you and the azure kitty before breaking into a wide grin and breaking into a sprint for the fray. "Good choice there — big tits and hips to match Hretha's. I'm sure that massive ass of hers will be a perfect fit for a prick like mine." Really, she decides whether to get involved or not by how fuckable her would-be rescuee is? "Yeah. What's the point if you're not offered a fuck by way of gratitude?" She's one to speak about that... |"More of the little menaces," Azyrran says as she keeps pace with you, short-lance and shield out and at the ready. "I know what it's like to feel alone against overwhelming odds... she doesn't have to be alone." |"Looks like we've got a little problem on our hands," Quin says with a whistle as he comes to a jog beside you. "Doesn't hurt that the girl's kinda my type... and even if she weren't, that's a fine piece of eye candy right there." You're going into battle and he's thinking of — "Hey, you've got to keep morale up and remember why you're here in the first place. Heads up!" |"Her magic is reasonably practiced and she is putting up a brave front, but she is about to be overwhelmed in short order," your fox-wife says as she pulls up beside you. Kiyoko doesn't run — she's too dignified for that — but she does move quickly and efficiently nevertheless. "We should hurry if we are to make a difference." |It's a second or two before you realize that Atugia hasn't joined the charge — looking over your shoulder, you see why. Your dullahan companion is eyeing the blue markings on the catgirl's exposed skin, markings that aren't too dissimilar from her own. Now's not the time for that, though. You shout back at Atugia, telling her to snap out of it, and she does. Looking slightly confused from losing her train of thought, she nevertheless grabs her [atugia.weapon] and makes to join the fray at your side. |"Oh no, more imps," Ryn says as she comes up beside you in a jog, already drawing back the string of her bow. "I can only imagine how she's feeling — I still remember when I encountered those horrid creatures for the first time..." ] Bursting out from under the cover of dim light, you strike at the imps, drawing a number of them to you; weapons sing and magic flashes in the damp air as you join the fray. It soon dawns upon the imps that their prey is no longer as easy as they thought it was and the little creatures soon scatter, gibbering and shrieking as they flee for the safety of the cavern ceiling. Grimacing, the azure kitten sends a couple gouts of whitefire to chase down the imps as they retreat; it's only when she's absolutely sure they won't be returning that she turns to [party.combatNames], places a hand on her chest and gives you a little bow and nod. "Thank you so much for your help. I'm Nihara."
rows.translation: 尽管现在在地下山脉中游荡可能是个不明智的决定，但你也不能让有需要的人独自面对困境。准备好你的…… [pc.weapon]你快步跑向那片混乱的区域，希望能在这些小家伙们还专注于其他事情的时候，抢先抓住他们。 [pc.bg acolyte minstrel noblescion scholar |提兰女祭司 |猫人 ]. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus kiyoko atugia etheryn |快！”凯特大喊着，冲了出去。“她的情况看起来不妙！ [pc.bg acolyte minstrel noblescion scholar |有趣的是，凯特会对一位提兰女祭司表现出如此关心——按照你目前对宗教政治的了解，这两种信仰之间不应该是处于一种友好的竞争关系中吗？ “嗯，她又不是特罗纳里安人，所以这没什么关系！再说，就算是对我最仇视的敌人，我也不会希望这种事情发生。” 就连卡希拉或托卢斯也不会希望这种事情发生吗？ “嗯， 他们 这个问题本来就是他们自己造成的……但暴君们可没有责任！拜托，别这样吧。 [pc.name]我们差不多要抓到他们了！ |啊，凯特又来帮忙了，她总是乐于帮助那些需要帮助的人。 “嘿，是你先挑起的这场事吧。”凯特向你眨了眨眼，“还是说，你帮助她只是因为她有着漂亮的胸部和迷人的臀部？ [pc.cunningRange 65 |没错。就是那些胸部和臀部——这就是你那晚把凯特从地上抱起来的原因，因为对于一只小猫来说，她的胸部确实很大。 |嘿！ ] 好了，不再逗你了。我们来看看能做些什么吧，好吗？ ] |布林特没有说任何话，但很快就开始想办法为自己发挥作用——对于这样一个体型庞大的人来说，只要他下定决心，行动起来其实可以相当迅速。他用肩膀撞开了其中一个小妖怪，而他的米诺陶尔伙伴则用另一只手部把另一个小妖怪拍开了。 [brint.weapon]这让那只蓝色的小猫有了重新站起来的机会。 |布蕾妮没有说任何话，但很快就开始想办法为自己做点事情——对于一个身材如此高大的人来说，只要下定决心，她行动起来其实可以非常迅速。她用肩膀轻轻碰了一下其中一个小家伙，然后又用另一只手部把另一个小家伙拍开了。 [brienne.weapon]这让那只蓝色的小猫有了重新站起来的机会。 |看到你冲了上去，阿罗娜犹豫了一下，目轻型在你和那只蔚蓝色的小猫之间来回扫视，然后突然露出了灿烂的笑容，也开始朝着战斗现场飞奔而去。 “这个选择真不错——那丰满的胸部和臀部，简直和赫蕾莎一样完美。 我敢肯定，她那庞大的身躯绝对适合像我这样的家伙。” 说真的，她是不是要根据那个她打算“拯救”的人有多容易上床来决定是否要介入呢？ “没错。 如果连最基本的感谢都没有，那这一切还有什么意义呢？” 她自己不也正是这么说的吗…… |又是一些小麻烦……”阿兹兰一边与你保持同步，一边手部持短矛、盾牌，随时准备应对攻击，说道，“我知道面对压倒性的困难时，孤独是什么感觉……她不必独自面对这一切。 |看来我们遇到点小麻烦了，”奎因边说边吹着口哨，慢步走到你身边。“不过这个女孩确实挺合我口味的……就算不合口味，她也是个相当漂亮的女生啊。” 你即将投入战斗，而他却在想着这些…… “嘿，你可得保持士气，记住自己最初来这里的目的。小心点！ |她的魔法技巧还算娴熟，也一直在努力保持镇定，但很快她就会不堪重负的，”你的狐狸妻子边说边停在你身边。清子并没有…… 运行 她的气质太高贵了，不适合做那种事……”不过，她的动作确实迅速而高效。“如果我们想真正发挥作用的话，就必须抓紧时间了。 |过了一两秒，你才意识到阿图吉娅并没有加入这场追逐——当你回头看时，你就明白了原因。你的同伴正盯着那个猫女暴露在外的皮肤上的蓝色纹路，那些纹路与她自己身上的纹路颇为相似。 不过，现在可不是关心这个的时候。你大声叫住阿图吉娅，让她回过神来，她果然听话地停下了动作。虽然看起来有些困惑，似乎暂时忘记了刚才在想什么，但她还是迅速拿起了武器…… [atugia.weapon] 并前来加入你的战斗，与你并肩作战。 |哦不，又来了那些小妖精，”瑞恩边说边小跑着来到你身边，同时已经拉开了弓弦。“我真能想象她现在该有多难受……我还记得我第一次遇到那些可怕的生物时的情景…… ] 在昏暗的轻型线中突然现身，你向那些小妖怪发起攻击，将它们吸引到了你的面前；在潮湿的空气中，武器发出鸣响，魔法轻型芒闪烁，你加入了这场战斗。那些小妖怪很快意识到，他们的猎物并不像他们想象的那么容易捕捉，于是这些小生物们开始惊慌失措，发出尖叫和咕哝声，四散逃向洞穴的顶部，试图寻找安全的地方。 那只蓝色的小猫皱着眉头，喷出几道白火，追击着那些正在逃窜的小妖精；直到它确定它们再也不会回来时，才转身离去。 [party.combatNames]她将一只手部放在胸前，轻轻鞠了一躬，点了点头。 “非常感谢你的帮助。我叫尼哈拉。
rows.raw: " However ill-advised as it might be to go wandering in the undermountain as it is right now, you can't leave someone in need to their own devices. Readying your [pc.weapon], you make a beeline for the scuffle at a jog, hoping to get the drop on the imps while their attention is still focused on the [pc.bg acolyte minstrel noblescion scholar |Tiran priestess |catfolk ]. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus kiyoko atugia etheryn |"Hurry!" Cait yells, breaking forward into a run. "It doesn't look good for her!" [pc.bg acolyte minstrel noblescion scholar |Interesting that Cait would be showing such concern for a Tiran priestess — aren't the two faiths in a bit of a friendly rivalry, as you understand religious politics at the moment? "Well, she's not a Tronariian, so it doesn't matter! That, and I wouldn't wish that on even my greatest enemy!" Not even Kasyrra or Tollus? "Well, they created the problem to begin with... but not the Tirans! Come on, [pc.name], we're almost on them!" |Ah, there goes Cait again, ever willing to help anyone in need. "Hey, you're the one who started it." Cait gives you a wink. "Or are you saying you're helping her only because she's got big tits and a nice ass?" [pc.cunningRange 65 |Exactly. Tits and ass — it's exactly why you picked Cait up off the ground that night, because she's got a huge pair on her for a kitten. |Hey! ] "All right, enough teasing you. Let's see what we can do about this, won't we?" ] |Brint doesn't say anything, but sets about making himself useful in short order — for someone so large, he can move quickly when he sets his mind to it. Checking one of the imps with his shoulder, your minotaur companion swats another away with his [brint.weapon], giving the azure kitty an opening to pick herself up again. |Brienne doesn't say anything, but sets about making herself useful in short order — for someone so large, she can move quickly when she sets her mind to it. Checking one of the imps with her shoulder, your cowgirl companion swats another away with her [brienne.weapon], giving the azure kitty an opening to pick herself up again. |Seeing you dash forward, Arona hesitates a bit, turning her gaze between you and the azure kitty before breaking into a wide grin and breaking into a sprint for the fray. "Good choice there — big tits and hips to match Hretha's. I'm sure that massive ass of hers will be a perfect fit for a prick like mine." Really, she decides whether to get involved or not by how fuckable her would-be rescuee is? "Yeah. What's the point if you're not offered a fuck by way of gratitude?" She's one to speak about that... |"More of the little menaces," Azyrran says as she keeps pace with you, short-lance and shield out and at the ready. "I know what it's like to feel alone against overwhelming odds... she doesn't have to be alone." |"Looks like we've got a little problem on our hands," Quin says with a whistle as he comes to a jog beside you. "Doesn't hurt that the girl's kinda my type... and even if she weren't, that's a fine piece of eye candy right there." You're going into battle and he's thinking of — "Hey, you've got to keep morale up and remember why you're here in the first place. Heads up!" |"Her magic is reasonably practiced and she is putting up a brave front, but she is about to be overwhelmed in short order," your fox-wife says as she pulls up beside you. Kiyoko doesn't run — she's too dignified for that — but she does move quickly and efficiently nevertheless. "We should hurry if we are to make a difference." |It's a second or two before you realize that Atugia hasn't joined the charge — looking over your shoulder, you see why. Your dullahan companion is eyeing the blue markings on the catgirl's exposed skin, markings that aren't too dissimilar from her own. Now's not the time for that, though. You shout back at Atugia, telling her to snap out of it, and she does. Looking slightly confused from losing her train of thought, she nevertheless grabs her [atugia.weapon] and makes to join the fray at your side. |"Oh no, more imps," Ryn says as she comes up beside you in a jog, already drawing back the string of her bow. "I can only imagine how she's feeling — I still remember when I encountered those horrid creatures for the first time..." ] Bursting out from under the cover of dim light, you strike at the imps, drawing a number of them to you; weapons sing and magic flashes in the damp air as you join the fray. It soon dawns upon the imps that their prey is no longer as easy as they thought it was and the little creatures soon scatter, gibbering and shrieking as they flee for the safety of the cavern ceiling. Grimacing, the azure kitten sends a couple gouts of whitefire to chase down the imps as they retreat; it's only when she's absolutely sure they won't be returning that she turns to [party.combatNames], places a hand on her chest and gives you a little bow and nod. "Thank you so much for your help. I'm Nihara." "

rows.original: With more and more imps joining the fray as they sense easy prey, your previous assessment of the situation soon becomes a reality; unable to keep up with the numbers and attacks from all angles, the azure kitty is soon overwhelmed by the gang of marauding imps. More audacious than its siblings, one of the disgusting little creatures flies straight into her, jabbing its oversized prick between her clothes and into her cleavage; she squeals at the sudden lewd intrusion and bats away the offending menace with a smack. That's enough of a diversion for a trio of imps to swoop down and grab her by the arm, followed by another three that seize her by a plush thigh, throwing her off-balance. The azure kitty lands on her butt atop the damp sand with a feline yelp, upon which the imps set on her in earnest. It's not a pretty sight — the disgusting little creatures have been turned on by their exertions, are determined to make the cat pay all the more for offering resistance, or both. Whatever the case, horrid creatures soon tear aside her garments and set to work, not even pausing to taunt her over their victory. The azure kitty struggles, her hair undulating and moving prehensile as she tries to fight off the imps, her locks behaving like tentacles as she endeavors to tear the imps away from her. The situation quickly devolves into an outright gangbang, another imp pulling her head back and forcing its outsized member into her mouth while more gather atop her legs, ramming their pricks between her plush thighs even as they pin down her limbs with a concerted effort. It's not pretty, although you have to wonder why for all their depredations, the horrid creatures don't outright fuck her. The azure kitty puts up a little bit more of a fight, but eventually loses the will to resist as the imps continue to swarm her, alternating between shoving their pricks into her and smearing their corrupted cum all over her body; feline hisses and yowls turn into whimpering, pleading moans as the imps prove that they're no less brutish in their desire for gratification than their larger brethren. Eventually, though, the imps' appetites are sated, if only for a little while. Giggling and chittering amongst themselves, the winged menaces wipe their drooling pricks off on what little relatively dry patches are left on the azure kitten, then take off towards the cavern's high ceiling in search of fresh and perhaps less troublesome prey. It's only when you're sure they're well and truly gone that you emerge from where you've been hiding and watching the whole scene, carefully approaching the downed catgirl in her pool of stinking imp cum as if she might spring up and... well, she doesn't look like she has it in her for that, but it can't hurt to be careful. Getting a little water from the lake, you gather it in your hands and splash it upon the azure kitten's face; after a couple times, she moans and comes to, eyes fluttering open and then gasping as she realizes just what it is she's covered in. You give her a few more helpful splashes, then step aside as the catgirl shuffles over to the lakeside and tries to wash off the viscous, corrupted spunk from her body as best as she can. It doesn't work very well. "Did... did you drive them off? The imps?" Uh, no. By the time you got to her, she was already lying on the beach out cold. Is she fine? The azure kitten stops splashing water on herself and scrubbing her limbs to consider your question. "No. If anything, I feel quite ill and disgusted from that entire ordeal. "But you don't look like one of those demons who're supposedly infesting these tunnels, so allow me to introduce myself. I'm Nihara."
rows.translation: 随着越来越多的小妖精察觉到这里有容易捕获的猎物而加入这场争斗，你之前对局势的判断很快就变成了现实：由于数量太多，而且攻击来自各个方向，那只蔚蓝色的小猫很快就被这群肆无忌惮的小妖精们压倒了。 比它的同类们更加大胆，其中一只令人作呕的小生物径直飞向她，将它那过大的生殖器插入她的衣物之间，刺入了她的胸腔；面对这种突如其来的淫秽侵犯，她发出了尖叫，然后猛地一拍将这个讨厌的家伙赶走了。 这三个小淘气趁机扑上来，抓住她的手部臂；紧接着又有另外三个小家伙抓住她柔软的大腿，把她弄得失去了平衡。那只蔚蓝色的小猫发出一声猫叫，落在了潮湿的沙地上，正好坐在她的屁股上。于是，这些小淘气们便真正地开始欺负她了。 这一幕实在不忍直视——那些令人作呕的小生物被自己的努力激起了斗志，它们决心要让这只猫为反抗付出更大的代价，或者两者皆是。无论如何，这些可怕的生物很快便撕开了她的衣物，开始行动起来，甚至没有停下来嘲笑自己的胜利。 那只蓝色的小猫正在拼命挣扎，它的毛发如同触手部般灵活地摆动，试图将那些小妖精从自己身上拉开。情况很快变得一发不可收拾，另一个小妖精强行将它的头向后拉，将自己的巨大器官塞进它的嘴里，而其他小妖精则聚集在它的双腿上，用它们的尖刺刺入它柔软的大腿，同时齐心协力地压制它的四肢。 虽然看起来并不美观，但人们不禁会想：既然这些可怕的生物对她进行了种种侵害，为什么却不直接侵犯她的身体呢？那只蔚蓝色的小猫虽然进行了一些抗性，但最终还是失去了反抗的意志——那些小妖精们不断地围攻她，时而用它们的尖刺刺她，时而又把它们那被腐蚀的精液涂抹在她的身上。猫一般的嘶嘶声和哀嚎声渐渐变成了呜咽和恳求般的呻吟，因为这些小妖精们证明了：在追求满足感的欲望上，它们并不比那些体型更大的同类逊色半分。 然而，最终这些小妖怪的食欲还是得到了满足，哪怕只是暂时而已。它们咯咯笑着、叽叽喳喳地互相交流，用身上那些相对干燥的地方擦去口水，然后飞向洞穴的高顶，去寻找更新鲜、也许也不那么麻烦的猎物。 只有当你确定它们确实已经离开后，你才会从藏身之处走出来，观察整个场景，然后小心翼翼地靠近那个倒在满是恶臭精液的池子中的猫女——你生怕她会突然跳起来……嗯，她看起来并不像是那种会这么做的人。 那个不过，小心总没有坏处。你从湖里取了一些水，把水捧在手部中，然后泼在那只蔚蓝色小猫的脸上；过了几秒钟，它开始呻吟着醒了过来，眼睛缓缓睁开，然后突然倒吸一口凉气，因为它这才意识到自己身上沾满了什么。 你再给她浇上几下有用的水，然后退到一边，让那个猫女走到湖边，尽她所能地清洗掉身上那些黏稠、腐烂的物质。不过效果并不是很好。 你…你把它们赶走了吗？那些小妖精？” “呃，没有。等你赶到她身边的时候，她已经冻倒在海滩上了。她现在没事吧？” 那只蔚蓝色的小猫停止了用水泼自己、清洗四肢的动作，开始思考你的问题。 不。事实上，经历了那一系列事情之后，我感到非常不适，甚至感到恶心。 “不过你看起来并不像那些据说在隧道里出没的恶魔，那么允许我自我介绍一下吧。我叫尼哈拉。

rows.translation: 谨慎才是真正的勇敢。你应该密切观察局势，做好应对准备，只有当事情完全失控时，才采取行动。
rows.raw: "Discretion is the better part of valor. You'll keep an eye on the situation, prepare for clean-up, and only step in if things get too out of hand "

rows.original:
"As I told you before, I live here out of necessity — the nature of my being demands that I remain close to water, or suffer for it. Drying out is not anything I care for, so I can hardly seek refuge in Khor'minos were the biggest bodies of open water around are the fountains from which the locals fill their buckets."
        
        [party.has cait
            |"Back in Jassira, her kind have to live near oases or by the rivers that flow out of Tronarii," Cait adds. "If not, they dry out and die — that's why you don't see them in cities much."
        ]
        
        While that explains her having to remain outside of Khor'minos' protective walls, it doesn't account for her venturing out along the lakeshore, though. This home out over the lake looks fairly defensible, you'd have imagined she'd have holed herself up in here instead of venturing out and exposing herself to demons.
        
        "There are still people in this area," Nihara replies, her voice flat and even. "Patricians who for one reason or the other, refuse to flee for the safety of the city... and even one or two who have fled the city for their own rural holdings out here, saying that Khor'minos itself has already been infiltrated by demons and the inner quarters grow more and more disquieting by the day. I don't know how true that is, but whatever the reason, they are here along with those who are brave or foolhardy enough to follow them in their service. To be sure, many of the villas by the lakeshore are perfectly serviceable as fortresses despite being designed for pleasure, and as a priestess of Tira it is my duty to see to them and their medical needs even in these trying times. It would be a shame if anyone were to successfully resist a demonic invasion just to fall to injury or illness."
        
        [pc.bg acolyte scholar
            |Just so. All the theological writings on the matter clearly state that the goddess of death and time calls mortals to their final rest at their appointed hour — not one moment before or later.
            
            Nihara smiles at that. "Y
            |Huh, you'd have imagined that Tirans wouldn't have put stock in that kind of thing. Usually it's Lumia people call upon for healing.
            
            Nihara's pleasant smile thins just a little. "The goddess of death and time calls mortals to their final rest at their appointed hour — not one moment before or later. To have the thread cut too early is as great an affront to her as to have it measured out too long; y
        ]ou'd be surprised at how many aren't aware of that particular teaching, but unsurprisingly so. People tend to focus on the whole kings, nations and soldiers aspect of the goddess while choosing to not notice her less approachable side."
        
        "Up till now, I've been capable of protecting myself. The imps must've gotten frustrated and got as many of their number together as they could for revenge."
        
        [pc.isDK
            |Hmp. You know her kind — the genuine believers, self-sacrificing do-gooders who willingly throw themselves into the thick of things regardless of circumstance or personal danger. Even after this, she's not going to stop going out to do her thing, so you're not going to ask her to begin with.
            |Ah. You know her sort — there isn't going to be much point in asking her to stop, so you'll have to settle for asking her to be careful.
        ]
        
        "Well, it's not all about seeing to the patricians walled up in their villas," Nihara admits, running her fingers through her watery hair, a flowing, liquid noise accompanying the motion. "Despite appearances to the contrary, I can't live on water alone, and needs are as needs must. It's not something I'm proud of, but there are many properties here that've been abandoned for who knows how long... "
        
        Right. It would be a pity to see all the things the rich put away go to waste, it's not as if they would miss it, or she didn't earn it by her actions here.
        
        Nihara sighs, raising a hand to her cheek. "The necessity of scavenging doesn't make me feel any less guilty for it, but I can only hope the Lady of the Hourglass will forgive me for my transgressions when all this is over."
rows.translation:
正如我之前所说，我之所以住在这里，完全是出于无奈——我的本质决定了我必须靠近水源，否则就会陷入困境。对于我来说，干燥的环境简直是无法忍受的，因此当科尔米诺斯周围最大的开阔水域就是那些当地人用来打水的源泉时，我自然会选择在这里避难。
        
        [party.has cait
            |在贾西拉，她的族人必须生活在绿洲附近，或者沿着从特罗纳里流出的河流居住，”凯特补充道。“否则，他们就会干渴而死——这就是为什么你在城市里很少见到他们的原因。
        ]
        
        虽然这可以解释她为什么必须待在科尔米诺斯的保护墙之外，但却无法说明她为何会冒险沿着湖岸外出。这个位于湖边的住所看起来相当容易防守，你可能会认为她应该躲在这里，而不是冒险外出，让自己暴露在恶魔的威胁之下。
        
        这个地区仍然有人居住，”尼哈拉平静而平稳地回答道，“有些贵族出于种种原因，拒绝为了城市的安全而逃离……还有一两个人则是为了自己在这里的乡间领地而离开城市的，他们说科尔米诺斯本身已经被恶魔渗透了，城内的情况一天比一天更加令人不安。 我不知道这是否属实，但无论出于什么原因，他们来到了这里，还有一些人因为足够勇敢或鲁莽，也选择了跟随他们一起服役。事实上，许多湖边的别墅虽然原本是用来休闲娱乐的，但它们完全可以用作堡垒。作为蒂拉的女祭司，我的职责就是在这些艰难的时刻，确保这些设施以及人们的基本医疗需求得到满足。 如果有人好不容易成功抵御了恶魔的入侵，却因此受伤或生病，那未免太可惜了。
        
        [pc.bg acolyte scholar
            |确实如此。所有关于这一主题的神学著作都明确指出：死亡与时间的女神会在规定的时刻将凡人引领至最终的安息之地——绝对不会提前或推迟片刻。

尼哈拉听到这里笑了笑，说道：“是啊……
            |哈，你大概会认为暴君们不会相信那种事情吧。通常都是卢米亚人会寻求治愈吧。

尼哈拉那愉悦的笑容略微黯淡了一些。“死亡与时间的女神会在规定的时刻将凡人引领至最终的安息之地——早一刻也不行，晚一刻也不行。如果生命之线被过早地切断，这对她来说，就和它被延长得太久一样，都是莫大的侮辱。
        ]你会惊讶于竟然有那么多人没有意识到这一点的，不过这也并不奇怪。人们在谈论这位女神时，往往只关注她与国王、国家以及士兵们相关的方面，却忽视了她那些不那么为人所知的、较为内敛的一面。

“直到现在，我才能够保护自己。那些小妖精们肯定已经忍无可忍了，所以它们才召集了尽可能多的同伴来报复我。
        
        [pc.isDK
            |哼，你太了解她这种人了——那些真正的信徒，那些甘愿自我牺牲、无私奉献的人，无论面对什么情况或个人危险，都会毫不犹豫地投身到行动中去。就算发生了这种事，她也不会停止自己的行动，所以你本来也就不会要求她停止的。
            |啊，你了解她的性格——要求她停止这样做根本没什么用，所以你只能让她小心点罢了。
        ]
        
        嗯，事情并不只是为了照顾那些躲在别墅里的贵族们，”尼哈拉承认道，她的手指轻轻穿过湿漉漉的头发，那动作伴随着一阵轻柔的声响。“尽管表面上看似如此，但我总不能只靠空气和水分生存，人们的需求是客观存在的，必须得到满足。 这并不是什么让我引以为豪的事情，但这里有很多房产已经被废弃了，也不知道已经废弃了多久……”

确实。看着那些富人们曾经积累下来的东西被浪费掉，实在是一件可惜的事。他们并不会因为这些财产而感到缺少什么，而且这些财产也是他们在这里通过自己的努力赚来的。
        
        尼原叹了口气，用手捂住了脸颊。“虽然需要进行搜刮行动，但这并不会让我因此感到丝毫内疚。我只希望，当这一切结束后，沙漏女士能够原谅我的过错。"
