I am a woman who knows exactly what she wants, after all. |In fact, [pc.name], I do love them all so much that if you're up for it, I wouldn't mind making one or two more... are you up to the task, my dear? ]" |Purring, Nihara leans in close and cups her hefty tits, pushing them up and together so that they leak just a little. "It's amazing how much kittens have to drink, isn't it? It's not as if it's something I didn't know to begin with, but experiencing it for oneself really puts some perspective on the matter. They're growing kittens, and they need a lot to stay hydrated, being mostly water... which means I need to stay hydrated plenty as well. It's quite vexing, I'd say." Well, she does live above an entire lake, so there shouldn't be any trouble getting water. Nihara doesn't say anything to that, instead simply leaning forward in her chair and holding your gaze with that same little disquieting smile. It's painfully clear after a few moments of this that when she said hydration, she didn't mean water... |"You know, [pc.name], I didn't realize that I desired it before, but now that I've had kittens of my own, I'm determined to want a big family." Curious. What sparked this realization? It's not as if it's anything new; the local minotaurs certainly aren't shy about their desires in that regard. "I... I can't really put it into words, but I know full well what I want, [pc.name], I want it really badly, and I'm not about to be ashamed of saying so. Maybe you might call it an addiction to giving birth... I prefer to know it as the surety that there's something mysterious about having life growing inside of you that fills one's heart... and the firm weight of a kitten or two. "I'm sure that having helped set me on this path, you wouldn't mind helping me see it to its end, would you?" ...Ye gods, what might you just have unleashed here? "That's an attitude I'd love to see more of, [pc.name]," Nihara purrs, patting [nihara.pregStage 1 2 3 |the bulgy swell of her tummy |the firm, protruding swell of her kitten bump |the obscenely huge dome of her overstuffed womb |her flat tummy ]. "I'll be counting on you to do your part, okay?" |"Mmm... I don't know why, but I find myself craving more kittens..." [nihara.isPregnant |You know that Nihara's already in a motherly way, so for her to have such desires well ahead of time is... well, getting ahead of herself, to say the least. Unless she's saying that she can conceive more kittens while already pregnant... now wouldn't that be a sight to see, even if quite shocking. |Your eyes wander down to Nihara's lightly-muscled midriff, and your goocat lover teasingly flexes her abs, knowing full well that you're watching. Oh, she's healthy and more than willing to go... ] Is there... any particular reason, though? "Do I need a reason beyond simply liking it?" A small, disquieting smile on her lips, Nihara [nihara.isPregnant |shamelessly rubs her hands all over her rounded belly, blatantly taking pleasure in the act |leans in and blows you a kiss. ] "You know, [pc.name], when I was younger I'd hear of cowgirls who just wound up having massive families. They got started with one, and quickly found themselves just happening to have another, and another, and another... poor things just couldn't explain why although they knew they should really pace themselves, the calves just kept coming. Poor things couldn't help it — they just kept on slipping and falling, right onto the nearest, thickest prick, and wound up getting pregnant over and over again. "You could say they just about got addicted to it..." Um... Nihara purrs. "Oh, look at the expression on your face right now. I was mostly teasing, mostly. After all, if I'd really sunk to those depths I'd have jumped your bones already and mated with you as many times as it'd take to drain you completely dry, but I'm still here, aren't I? That being said, it's not out of the question that a poor helpless water wyrd like me could end up getting addicted to this if left unhydrated for too long..." ] |[rand |"Some might call having kittens in a time like this irresponsible, but after I let myself be convinced by you to make the leap, I haven't regretted it in the least. The moment I held the little mewling gooball in my arms, I knew I would move the world for my kittens." That's a very positive outlook on life, and it suits someone as peppy as her. "Sure, the tunnels may be running over with imps, but that's just an impetus to make my home safer than it already is. Water wyrds before me have raised kittens in war and peace, in lean times and plenty. It wasn't always perfect, but if my ancestors managed to keep on doing what they were doing during the Godswar, then I really don't have any excuse to give into fear of the future. After all, Tira teaches us to fear neither time nor death; her embrace is warm, and we are promised the length of our lives before fate cuts them short. "It's hope for the future, don't you know? And that's what's important — it's another reason to keep on going in a situation like this when there's no end in sight." Well, if she wants to make some more little gookittens... all she needs to do is ask. "Tsk. So forward." |Looking around Nihara's home does bring up one thing: while you know she's had your gookittens, you don't see anything resembling a nursery anywhere in her home. Not a crib to be seen, to be honest... "A crib? Gods forbid," Nihara replies, raising a hand to her mouth and giggling. "Not only would everything get damp, but your kittens would just ooze out from between the sides and land on the ground. Then I'd have a crying kitten with a nasty bump, and no one wants that." You understood that last part, but... ooze out from between the sides? "Water wyrds are a lot more pliant when we're young. My dad said it has something to do with us not having as strongly developed a sense of self or something, but apparently I couldn't be contained when I was a kitten, not that I remembered any of it to begin with. Anyway, a crib makes no sense. When I go to bed, I have the kittens cuddle up to me like a real mom cat would." And where do they go during the day? Who's taking care of them while she's out and about making her rounds or picking over the abandoned villas? "Oh, they just go into one of the bathing pools. Baby water wyrds dry out a lot easier then grown-ups or even children, so it's important to keep the young ones moist. While I know they'll be able to subsist on clean water for a bit before I can get home to nurse them, I can't help but feel a little guilty every time I've to lock up the house." It is what it is — she has to do what she has to in order to be a decent mother. All this talk about gookittens and all the special things they need to grow up well just makes your head spin, you're not sure you'd be able to get it all no matter how much Nihara explains it. |"Sometimes I wake up in the night, and my first thought is immediate terror that I might've rolled over and squashed one of my kittens. I feel like I've experienced the totality of what it means to be a mother. You hold for a moment, savoring the cool touch of skin and water-goo alike, and then finally pull away, leaving Nihara a little woozy. "Oh dear. I haven't felt so intense for a while now. And of course, I'm always there every time I let them out. Ah, of course. "Really... the kittens have nothing but extremes. Either they're bursting with energy and scampering and swimming all over the place, or draped limply over the nearest open surface. I haven't been a mother that long, and I'm already getting used to carrying kittens back to the lake house with me. At least I still remember how my own mother used to carry me around by the scruff of my neck when I was really little... that quiets them down really quickly." ] ] "

rows.original: [flags.NIHARA_PAMP |Nihara nods and smiles at your request. "Of course [pc.name] — I'm willing to offer you a little respite from what's out there in the tunnels, so long as you're willing to barter me something in exchange for the service. Does that sound fair to you? Come on, then — let's see what you have amongst those possessions of yours..." |"Ah." Nihara gives you a bright smile. "You'd like a service, then." If that's what she calls the things the minotaur patricians would come to her lake home for, then yes. A service. "Well, it couldn't hurt. I need to keep in practice — what I can do without the amenities that I quite carry around with me are limited. If you're willing to make it worth my time, I'm willing to dust off the spa and help you feel as good as new." Make it worth her time, as in... "Both you and I know full well what I meant by that." All right, then, you can understand that she'd want payment. How much? Nihara shakes her head. "No, no. Not in money — there's not much use I can get out of that given that getting into the city grows harder with each passing day, money's only useful in its ability to exchange it for what you actually need, after all. Think about it: you can't eat money, can't shelter in money, can't heat or cool yourself with money, can't treat your ailments with money, can't entertain yourself with money, can't light your house at night with money, can't get places with money. Once people stop accepting money for these things or they're not around to be had in the first place, it's just about worthless. "What I need is, well, food, for obvious reasons, and medicines that I can use in making my rounds. Even in the case that I can't use these directly or the gods see fit to bless with with a surplus, I can still use those to barter for other things that I need. Surely that can't be too much to ask for a little bit of relaxation from a trained Tiran priestess?" ]
rows.translation: [flags.NIHARA_PAMP |尼原听到你的请求后点了点头，微笑着回答：“当然可以。 [pc.name] 我愿意为你提供一些庇护，让你远离隧道里的危险，只要你愿意用一些东西来交换我的服务。你觉得这样公平吗？来吧，让我们看看你那些物品里有什么可以交换的…… |啊。”尼哈拉向你露出了灿烂的笑容，“那么，你是想要某种服务吧。” 如果她所说的就是那些弥诺陶洛斯的贵族们会来到她湖边的家中寻求的东西的话，那么，没错，我确实需要某种服务。 “嗯，试试也无妨嘛。 我需要不断练习——在没有那些我总是随身携带的便利工具的情况下，我的能力是有限的。如果你愿意让我花时间去做这件事，我愿意重新启用那些美容工具，帮你恢复最佳状态。一定要让她觉得自己的时间没有白费，也就是说……” “你和我都很清楚我这话的意思。” 那么，你应该能理解她会要求得到报酬吧。到底要多少呢？ 尼原摇了摇头。“不，不是钱的问题——考虑到进入这座城市的难度日益增加，钱其实并没有太大用处。毕竟，钱的意义在于用来换取你真正需要的东西。 想一想：你不能用钱来吃饭，不能用钱来遮风避雨，不能用钱来调节体温，不能用钱来治病，不能用钱来娱乐，不能用钱在晚上照亮房子，也不能用钱来出行。 一旦人们不再愿意为这些东西支付金钱，或者这些东西根本就不再存在了，那么它们就彻底失去了价值。 “我所需要的，就是…… 食物出于显而易见的原因，还有其他一些原因。 药品 这些资源完全可以用来完成我的日常任务。即使我无法直接使用它们，或者上天赐予我更多的资源，我仍然可以用它们来换取我需要的其他东西。对于一位受过训练的蒂兰女祭司来说，这样的要求应该不算过分吧？ ]

"It's true you don't have anything on you... but at the same time, I can't just let you go back out there looking like that. The vicar always said I was a little too soft-hearted for my own good, but she's not here right now and I'm capable of making my own decisions. "Come on, then. Let's see what we can do for those hurts of yours." Thinning her lips, Nihara gets up from her seat, gesturing for you to follow her. rows.original: "Oh my, it's gotten so dusty," Nihara murmurs to herself. "I never quite noticed. Let me do something about all of this..." You watch as Nihara opens a gate, letting lake water into the bathing pool, then gets a damp cloth and wipes down the massage slabs and other furniture while giving you an apologetic look. "Sorry for keeping you waiting, but I should be ready now. If you don't mind disrobing?" Here? Now? The goocat puts her hands together and wiggles her ears. "Did I not make myself clear enough? I've worked in this line of business for long enough to have seen plenty of people without their clothes, so there's no need to be shy. And before that, while at the temple, I've also seen plenty of people without their clothes... although in a lot less flattering fashion than what you'd expect at a spa." ... "Sorry about that, I guess I got more morbid that what was comfortable back there; most people don't want to think of embalming. But the point is what it is — don't think about it too much, and let yourself just relax and be at home." Her words are soothing, cool and yet thick and slow-flowing; you think she may or may not have tapped you with her tails a couple times — whatever the case, any reluctance you may have had at this melts away as you reach for your [pc.armor] and start pulling it off. Nihara reaches over to help you, and that washes aside the last of your hesitance. You did ask for this, after all. What did you expect? That she'd offer you a towel to preserve your modesty? This is minotaur country, after all. Slowly, Nihara leads you down the stepped edge into the bathing pool that dominates the middle of the room, the water cool enough to nip a little, but not to be outright uncomfortable. The goocat purrs demurely as she eases you into a sitting position, settles in behind you, and squeezes your shoulders in affirmation. You note that she hasn't undressed herself, but her priestess' garb seems to be made for the purpose of getting wet and clinging to the contours of her body. "Now, let's begin."

Nihara doesn't just use her hands to help you relax — even though the gooey locks of her hair meld seamlessly into the water's surface, you still feel them against your body. Not too different from the ebb and flow of the lake in the bathing pool, perhaps, but more powerful as they work out the tension from your muscles. The gelatinous tendrils work with her long, nimble fingers to really apply pressure deep beneath your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], getting out all those kinks while your head sinks further and further against Nihara's thighs — not that one's inclined to mind further indulgence in such a plush lap pillow.
    
    Do you hold a conversation? You don't quite remember, but the sound of Nihara's voice is all around you like the gentle sloshing of the lake, so you presumably must have been speaking with her even as you grow drowsier and drowsier while the priestess works your body from head to toe, using her goo-hair to work the places her fingers can't reach.
    
    You're getting tired... and distinctly aware of the heaving, [nihara.isPregnant
        |bigger-than-head-sized tits positioned right above your face that frame Nihara's gentle smile, beads of white cream already smelling sweet and welling up atop the dark fabric of her top
        |head-sized tits positioned right above your face that frame Nihara's gentle smile
    ].
    
    "Feeling shy?" she purrs. "There's no need to be in the least. This is my element, after all."
    
    While your head's in her laps and she's smiling down at you, Nihara works her fingers on your brows, then your cheeks and chin; her hair, sunk beneath the water's inky surface, caresses your limbs and tickles your feet. Were her locks that long to begin with? Who cares?
    
    "Looks like you're getting sleepy, [pc.name]. The water does that to people... don't worry, you won't catch a chill so long as I'm around to keep an eye on you. You can just relax and let you be yourself in this place, that's what it's for, after all."
    
    With one end of the pool open to the lake and the blue glow from Nihara's fungal garden and the distant mushroom forest filtering in across its surface, it's hard to not heed her words. At this point, you can't even tell if it's her fingers working at you, or if it's the lapping of the lake's tides against your skin... but these gentle, flighty touches are just a little erotic, if you choose to think of them that way.
    
    Do you?

While grave-robbing is out of the question, there are other things stored in the catacombs that may be useful to you in your line of work. That's about all that I can promise." You see. You'll need some time to think about it, then. "Please do consider it. You wouldn't be doing just me, but also everyone else in the lakeside district a favor; if you have any questions about what to expect, feel free to ask away. In the meantime... perhaps you'd like to pursue another topic?" "

rows.original: The goocat frows and swishes her tails at you mentioning the topic. "Oh? Did you want to ask more information about the place, [pc.name], or are you ready to go?
rows.translation: 那只猫儿皱起了眉头，摇着尾巴看着你，似乎在暗示你想要了解更多关于那个地方的信息。“哦？你是想了解更多关于那个地方的信息吗？ [pc.name]那么，你们准备好了吗？
rows.raw: '\n    The goocat frows and swishes her tails at you mentioning the topic. "Oh? Did you want to ask more information about the place, [pc.name], or are you ready to go?\n    '

rows.original:
"Well, as you know, the entire place has been overrun by corrupted slimes escaped from the farms. First the imps, and then after they left the slimes took over. Calise did tell me that there was an attempt to clear them out, but as you can imagine her Chargers' swords and maces weren't of much use against amorphous creatures. As strong as she might have been, she couldn't clear an entire horde of slimes all by herself and hence had to retreat."
        
        And Nihara thinks you can?
        
        "Well, we're not going to try and retake or cleanse the temple — I know full well that I don't have the power for that. Just a simple in and out, as the adventurer types would put it. I wouldn't be able to do it alone, but you come highly recommended, [pc.name]. Oh, and there's the matter of the ghosts, too."
        
        [party.has arona
            |Beside you, Arona rolls her eyes and plants her chin in her hands. "Right. Ghosts. Amazing. Just amazing, what I needed today to get me all nice and stiff. Ghosts."
        ]
        
        Ghosts, she said. Well, you're not completely surprised given that the temple was in a terrible state, but even so... 
        
        "It'd probably have been much, much worse if we hadn't sealed up the place before we left, [pc.name]. While the place is hardly as old as the catacombs under Khor'minos proper, they still have been in use for generations at this point, and a lot of people were interred during the Godswar."
        
        Okay, so slimes and ghosts. Does she have any suggestions?
        
        "I've got whitefire for the ghosts, and cold for the slimes. So long as you don't attempt mundane metal against either, you should be getting reasonably good results, although being of an corrosive nature acid probably isn't going to do much against the slimes, either. At the end of the day, it just boils down to common sense and a bit of luck. Like I said, Calise's Chargers weren't really able to do very much against either, so they had to retreat. We, however, have the benefit of foreknowledge, so I'm sure that we'll be able to do better with some preparation.[silly
            | There, since you bothered to ask, the author has very clearly given you information on what to prepare for this damned quest, as well as how to get around the likely obstacles. There's no excuse for whining 'oh, I can't beat this' when you were told exactly what to expect, so there.
        ]
        
        "Now, is there anything else you'd like to know?"
        
        Yes. The word %"catacombs" brings up images of long, winding tunnels deep beneath the earth — will it be a long trip?
        
        "Not really. While there're plenty of tunnels that're just for interring the dead and those do indeed wind deep into the mountain's roots, what with the entire place being an abandoned mine, most of the common-use areas are near the entrance. It should be just a quick in-and-out, less than an hour, really."
        
        All right, you don't think you have any more questions.
        
        "If you're willing to take the job, make your preparations and ask me about leaving when you're ready. For now, though... let's talk about something else, shall we?"
rows.translation:
嗯，如你们所知，整个地区都被从农场逃出来的变异黏液生物占领了。先是那些小妖精，等它们离开后，黏液生物就接管了这里。卡莉丝确实告诉过我，人们曾经试图清除这些生物，但可想而知，她的冲锋者们的剑和钉锤对这种无定形的生物来说根本没什么作用。 尽管她实力强大，但单凭一己之力是无法消灭整个群体的史莱姆的，因此她不得不撤退。

那么，尼哈拉认为你能做到吗？

“嗯，我们并不会试图重新夺回或净化那座寺庙——我非常清楚自己没有那样的能力。 用冒险者的话来说，就是一次简单的进出而已。我一个人是无法完成这个任务的，但听说你非常可靠，所以才来找你帮忙的。 [pc.name]哦，还有那些鬼魂的问题也需要处理。
        
        [party.has arona
            |在你旁边，阿罗娜翻了个白眼，然后把下巴搁在手上。“对啊，鬼魂……太神奇了，简直太棒了！今天正好需要这样的东西，才能让我整个人都变得僵硬起来……鬼魂啊。
        ]
        
        都是鬼魂的缘故，”她说。嗯，考虑到那座寺庙的状况已经糟糕到了极点，你其实也不应该感到太惊讶……但即便如此……

“如果我们在离开之前没有把那个地方封起来，情况可能会糟糕得多。 [pc.name]虽然这个地方的历史远没有科尔米诺斯城下的地下墓穴那么悠久，但它们也已经被使用了好几代人，而且在“神战”期间，也有很多人被安葬在这里。

好吧，所以这里有黏液生物和鬼魂…… 她有什么建议吗？

“对于鬼怪，我使用白火；而对于黏液生物，则使用寒冰。只要你不使用普通的金属来对付它们，应该就能得到相当不错的效果。不过，由于酸具有腐蚀性，所以对黏液生物来说可能也没什么作用。 归根结底，这一切都取决于常识和一点点运气。就像我之前说的，卡莉丝率领的冲锋者队面对这两支队伍时确实毫无办法，所以他们不得不撤退。然而，我们拥有先知先觉的优势，因此我相信，只要做好充分的准备，我们肯定能够取得更好的成绩。[silly
            | 看吧，既然你特意问了，作者已经非常清楚地告诉你们了为完成这个该死的任务需要准备什么，以及如何克服可能遇到的障碍。既然已经明确告诉你们会遇到什么困难，那就没有理由再抱怨“哦，我打不过这个任务”了，明白吗？
        ]
        
        那么，还有其他你想了解的事情吗？”

“有。‘地窖’这个词会让人联想到那些深入地下的漫长而蜿蜒的隧道——那么这段路程会很长吗？”

“其实不会。虽然确实有很多隧道是用来安葬死者的，那些隧道确实会延伸到山脉的深处，但既然整个地方都是一座废弃的矿山，那么大多数供人们使用的区域其实都位于入口附近。 应该只需要很快就能完成，用不到一个小时吧。”

“好的，你确定没有其他问题要问了吗？”

“如果你愿意接受这份工作，那就做好准备工作，等准备妥当了再告诉我你什么时候可以出发。 不过，现在先聊点别的吧？

rows.original: Ask about what dangers you're likely to face in the Tiran catacombs.
rows.translation: 询问在提兰地下墓穴中你可能会遇到哪些危险。
rows.raw: "Ask about what dangers you're likely to face in the Tiran catacombs."

rows.original: All right, you're as ready as you'll ever be for this. A quick in-and-out, she said? Nihara gives you a weak smile. "That's the plan. Of course, no plan ever survives contact with the enemy, as the saying goes, but we'll do our best. Come on, let's be off." With that, the goocat grabs a small satchel and her staff from behind the door — unassuming objects by the looks of them, but doubtlessly much loved and treasured given how carefully she handles both items. Giving you a nod, Nihara gestures towards the door. "Let's be off." If she doesn't mind leading the way... The tunnels are largely empty, although you can hear the sounds of clashing and metal upon metal in the distance — some skirmish no doubt drawing attention away — and [party.combatNames] make it to the Tiran temple unmolested. The place is still in as much of a shambles as it was when you saw it for the first time from the crossroads, and after a cursory examination of the courtyard and fountain it looks like it's safe. While there're several slimes lurking around the edges and walls, they don't appear to have noticed you. "Hurry, before we're spotted. And tread lightly, the slimes sense people by vibration." [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus kiyoko atugia etheryn |"Oooo, getting to go into Tiran catacombs," Cait whispers as you all sneak past the fountain. "Not something a Jassiran Mallachite gets to do every day." You know that Jassira and Tronarii have been at loggerheads since forever over Mallach and Tira, but that animosity hasn't spread all the way to this part of the world. Still, it's not a surprise that Tirans take their burial grounds seriously. If it weren't for this, the lot of you wouldn't be waltzing into the catacombs no sweat. "To say that we're at loggerheads would be a bit of an exaggeration, but it's not untrue," Cait replies with a pout. "All I wanted to say is that I'm getting to see something that most people don't get to." Well, she forsook the temple in order to see the world, and she's getting it. |As you creep through the courtyard, Brint looks a little contemplative, his eyes flickering over every so often to the sealed doors of the Tiran temple and the symbol etched upon them. Pensive? There must be thousands upon thousands of minotaurs and more laid to rest in these tunnels. That, and Nihara said there would be ghosts, so... "It's not the ghosts I'm afraid of, [pc.name]. I'm just... thoughtful. When I was younger, I was tempted to go up here and ask if my dad was in the catacombs. On the off-chance that something had happened to him and if he was laid to rest there, you see." ...Did he? "No, when I thought about it longer, it would've been a silly thing to do. That would've supposed that he was dead, that someone had brought his body to the Tirans for a proper burial, that someone had managed to identify him, and the Tirans still remembered him in their records. The chances of that weren't worth sitting half the afternoon away just waiting for someone to flip through all the dusty records." And maybe he didn't want to run the risk of finding out for sure. "Maybe. I'm not denying that." |As you creep through the courtyard, Brienne looks a little contemplative, her eyes flickering over every so often to the sealed doors of the Tiran temple and the symbol etched upon them. Pensive? There must be thousands upon thousands of minotaurs and more laid to rest in these tunnels. That, and Nihara said there would be ghosts, so... "It's not the ghosts I'm afraid of, [pc.name]. I'm just... thoughtful. When I was younger, I was tempted to go up here and ask if my dad was in the catacombs. On the off-chance that something had happened to him and if he was laid to rest there, you see." ...Did she? "No, when I thought about it longer, it would've been a silly thing to do. That would've supposed that he was dead, that someone had brought his body to the Tirans for a proper burial, that someone had managed to identify him, and the Tirans still remembered him in their records. The chances of that weren't worth sitting half the afternoon away just waiting for someone to flip through all the dusty records." And maybe she didn't want to run the risk of finding out for sure. "Maybe. I'm not denying that." |Arona scowls as she tiptoes across the courtyard, a comical sight for a hefty orc like her. [arona.weapon] in hand and her fingers gripping it so tightly that her knuckles are white, her eyes dart back and forth, peering into the shadows by the walls, expecting something to leap out at all of you without warning. Really, you haven't even reached the catacombs yet and she's already acting so jumpy. [flags.ARONA_TOTEM |Besides, what's there to be afraid of now that she can smack ghosts like any other foe? If anything, they should be the ones afraid of her. "Hey, just because you can fight back doesn't mean you don't have to stay on your toes." Arona? Showing caution and prudence when it comes to fighting foes? That's most unlike her. If she keeps up this pretense, someone might actually imagine that she's genuinely afraid. Wouldn't that be awful for the image of a big, strong orc like her. "J-just shut up already, you! Lumia's tits, seriously. I don't know why I let you drag me around on these trips of yours." Because she gets to meet all sorts of interesting people and fight them, like what you're doing now. "Ghosts aren't people, you dumbass!" Then what are they? "Ghosts!" |If she keeps acting like this, someone might get the wrong idea and think that she's afraid of ghosts. "I ain't afraid of no ghost, buster. I'm just... aware that there's not fucking much I can do on this stupid trip of yours. Like, what am I even supposed to do against a slime? Splat it? It'll just flow back together again! And ghosts? Come on, you can't seriously expect me to hit those! Once again, why the fuck did you even bring me here? It's not like you didn't know what to expect going in, right?" Please, she really needs to take a breath before she passes out or attracts all the goos in the courtyard with the yelling she's doing. "Fuck." Arona heaves a sigh and stares at you accusatory. "Once more, why'd you even bother dragging me along, anyway? You know my [arona.weapon] isn't going to do shit against anything in there, right?" Sure, but she's big and meaty and can put herself in between you and danger. That's her most prominent attribute, isn't it? Big... and meaty. Arona chuckles dryly. "You don't have to flatter me, asshole, I'm already here. Although if you do really want to show your appreciation, presenting your ass for me after we're through with this would be a good start." ] |"I don't like this place," Azyrran mutters, looking around with her big black eyes and [azyrran.weapon] at the ready. "It gives me the creeps." Is she afraid, then? "No, I'm not afraid, but that doesn't mean I have to like this sepulcher all the same. It's a place of parting, of goodbyes, and while I know it's inevitable someday it's also not something I'm ready for just yet." Especially when she came so close to it before. "The day will come when I won't be with my mother and sisters anymore, [pc.name]. Either that, or I'll be the first to go. But for now, that day's comfortably ahead of us all, thanks to you... and not something I want to give too much thought to here and now." |"Hmph," Quin snorts as he tiptoes alongside you through the courtyard. "Another of these places. The imps and slimes really did a number on the place, didn't they? It can't have been that long since I fucked off from Tollus and his posse... even if all this shit went down immediately after, which I doubt, this place looks like it's been abandoned for years. Trust me, that kind of feel doesn't come easily." He'd know, would he? "Before all this happened, it was pretty common for Tollus to scrounge around places like this — sometimes, he'd get so excited that he'd join in the excavations himself. That, or he was so much of a mistrustful bastard that he worried his underlings would hide any important finds from him. But yeah, I got to see a whole bunch of places like these over a couple of years — abandoned, overgrown, half-buried, once you've seen enough of them they all just kind of blend into each other, especially when more than half have been picked clean or everything's rotted away already. Them's the breaks, I guess." |"An interesting design," Kiyoko muses, looking around her. "The sturdy nature of the structure belies its purpose — it reminds me of the kirin vaults where the dedicants of the goddess keep their... things. But this is a vault for the dead, and not one of treasures; they are already restless, and we should tread lightly." Much call for graveyards in her homeland? "Less than here. Cremation is also an acceptable method of dealing with the dead, cheaper and more... ah, compact. By the way your priestess friend described the catacombs both attached to the temple and under the grand city of Khor'minos itself, she gave the impression that this mountain is filled to the brim with the bones of its inhabitants past. It is a somber and humbling thought all at once, and the architecture of a people speaks volumes about them." |"Oh wow," Atugia muses quietly, looking about her. "It's very heavy and dark. Kind of reminds me of Carmen's place, when you get down to it. Not just the color of the stone, but also the sense of weight to it, like it's trying to crush you just for staring at the walls too hard." Now that Atugia's pointing it out... yeah, you can kind of see the similarity between the Tiran temple and Castle Hawkstone. It's unlikely that the builders of both were one and the same, but you can see the architectural influences one had on the other. Does she know if the baroness contracted minotaurs to put up the castle? "Dunno, that was before my time. Or before Carmen's time too, to be honest. Her father might've been the one to have the castle built, or it might've been her grandfather... maybe I oughta have paid more attention when she was telling me all this stuff. But given that they really know how to give a building feel, it wouldn't surprise me if it really was cow-people who laid the foundations of Castle Hawkstone." |As all of you creep through the shadows of the courtyard, you can't help but catch Ryn eyeing the Tiran temple — sealed shut as it is, the structure nevertheless looks all the more imposing for you being up close. Penny for her thoughts? "Oh no, it's nothing. I was just thinking... I was just thinking how similar this looked like the crypts beneath the palace. It's got that same weighty feel to it, doesn't it?" Well, that's where you've got to disagree with her. These may both be resting places of the dead, but when one's dedicated to Lumia and the other to Tira, the atmosphere is bound to be different, and not just because adherents of either goddess have pretty different views on just about every aspect of death. You're not chiding her or anything, but it might be worth thinking on. Ryn's quiet for the rest of the trip through the courtyard, clearly reflecting on what you've just said. ] Eventually, Nihara leads you around the side of the temple to a wall in the back where its joins into the natural tunnel, brushing aside several pieces of fallen debris to reveal a stairwell leading downwards. The air's a bit stale, but still breathable, and whitefire flares up on the tip of her staff, lighting your way as you make the descent. While chills run down the back of your neck, no spectres or slime show up to accost you — yet — and you're able to reach the bottom landing unmolested. "All right, I'll open up the catacombs. A moment, please." Indeed, set in the northern wall is an enormous granite door with the symbol of a moon-etched hourglass set into the dark rock. As Nihara steps up and presses her hand squarely into the middle of the crescent moon, golden lines flow outward from her palm to fill in the hourglass — with a faint rumble and outward puff of stale air, the doors swing open, showing you the way into the pitch-black catacombs ahead. Even from here, you can see lines upon lines of recesses in the rock walls, filled to the brim with big, bovine bones; there're crystal holders for lights, but it's been a long while since any of them have been replaced and it's all gone dark. Well then, nothing for it. She knows where this ward she's looking for is, right? "Like I said, we shouldn't need to go too far — the older ossuaries are sealed off further as well, so we won't get lost. If you will?" All right, then. With Nihara's flame guiding your way, you step down into the musty tunnels...
rows.translation: 好吧，你已经为这次行动做好了充分的准备。她说只需要快速进入然后迅速撤离而已？” 尼原勉强挤出了一个微笑：“没错，就是这个计划。当然，正如那句俗话所说，没有任何计划能够在与敌人的实际接触中依然有效，但我们会尽我们最大的努力的。 快点，我们出发吧。” 说完，这只小猫从门后拿起了一个小包和她的手杖——这些物品看起来很普通，但从她小心翼翼地对待它们的方式来看，无疑都是她非常珍爱和宝贝的东西。 尼原点了点头，然后朝门口示意。 “我们走吧。” 如果她不介意带路的话…… 这些隧道里基本上空无一人，不过远处可以听到金属碰撞的声音——显然有些小冲突正在发生，从而吸引了人们的注意…… [party.combatNames] 尽快赶到提兰神庙，不要惹上任何麻烦。那个地方依然和你第一次从十字路口看到它时一样一片混乱，不过在粗略地检查了庭院和喷泉之后，看起来应该是安全的。虽然周围的一些黏液生物潜伏在墙边和角落里，但它们似乎并没有注意到你。 “快点，趁我们还没被发现。还有，走路要轻点，那些黏液生物是通过震动来感知人的存在的。 [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus kiyoko atugia etheryn |哦哦哦，终于要进入提兰地窖了……”当你们悄悄绕过喷泉时，凯特轻声说道，“对于一个贾西拉·玛拉基特来说，这种事情可不是每天都能遇到的。” 你们都知道，贾西拉和特洛纳里一直以来都在为玛拉基特和提兰的问题争斗不休，但这种敌意并没有蔓延到这个地区来。 不过，暴君们如此重视自己的墓地，这也并不奇怪。如果不是因为这个原因，你们这些人也不会那么轻易地就走进那些地下墓穴吧。 “说我们之间存在着严重的矛盾，或许有点夸张，但事实确实如此。 不真实我只是想说，我有机会看到一些大多数人看不到的东西而已，”凯特撅着嘴回答道。 嗯，她放弃了寺庙的生活，就是为了去看这个世界，而现在她确实看到了。 即使从这里，你也能看到岩壁上那一排排的凹槽，里面堆满了巨大的牛骨；那里还有用来放置水晶灯的支架，但很久以来再也没有人更换过这些水晶灯了，所以现在一切都陷入了一片暗影之中。 那么，没什么问题了。她应该知道自己要找的那个墓室在哪里吧？ “就像我说的，我们不需要走得太远——那些较古老的墓室也被封闭得更好了，所以我们不会迷路的。你愿意跟我一起来吗？” 好吧，那么在尼哈拉的火焰指引下，你踏入了那些充满霉味的隧道……
rows.raw: " All right, you're as ready as you'll ever be for this. A quick in-and-out, she said? Nihara gives you a weak smile. "That's the plan. Of course, no plan ever survives contact with the enemy, as the saying goes, but we'll do our best. Come on, let's be off." With that, the goocat grabs a small satchel and her staff from behind the door — unassuming objects by the looks of them, but doubtlessly much loved and treasured given how carefully she handles both items. Giving you a nod, Nihara gestures towards the door. "Let's be off." If she doesn't mind leading the way... The tunnels are largely empty, although you can hear the sounds of clashing and metal upon metal in the distance — some skirmish no doubt drawing attention away — and [party.combatNames] make it to the Tiran temple unmolested. The place is still in as much of a shambles as it was when you saw it for the first time from the crossroads, and after a cursory examination of the courtyard and fountain it looks like it's safe. While there're several slimes lurking around the edges and walls, they don't appear to have noticed you. "Hurry, before we're spotted. And tread lightly, the slimes sense people by vibration." [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran quintillus kiyoko atugia etheryn |"Oooo, getting to go into Tiran catacombs," Cait whispers as you all sneak past the fountain. "Not something a Jassiran Mallachite gets to do every day." You know that Jassira and Tronarii have been at loggerheads since forever over Mallach and Tira, but that animosity hasn't spread all the way to this part of the world. Still, it's not a surprise that Tirans take their burial grounds seriously. If it weren't for this, the lot of you wouldn't be waltzing into the catacombs no sweat. "To say that we're at loggerheads would be a bit of an exaggeration, but it's not untrue," Cait replies with a pout. "All I wanted to say is that I'm getting to see something that most people don't get to." Well, she forsook the temple in order to see the world, and she's getting it. |As you creep through the courtyard, Brint looks a little contemplative, his eyes flickering over every so often to the sealed doors of the Tiran temple and the symbol etched upon them. Pensive? There must be thousands upon thousands of minotaurs and more laid to rest in these tunnels. That, and Nihara said there would be ghosts, so... "It's not the ghosts I'm afraid of, [pc.name]. I'm just... thoughtful. When I was younger, I was tempted to go up here and ask if my dad was in the catacombs. On the off-chance that something had happened to him and if he was laid to rest there, you see." ...Did he? "No, when I thought about it longer, it would've been a silly thing to do. That would've supposed that he was dead, that someone had brought his body to the Tirans for a proper burial, that someone had managed to identify him, and the Tirans still remembered him in their records. The chances of that weren't worth sitting half the afternoon away just waiting for someone to flip through all the dusty records." And maybe he didn't want to run the risk of finding out for sure. "Maybe. [arona.weapon] in hand and her fingers gripping it so tightly that her knuckles are white, her eyes dart back and forth, peering into the shadows by the walls, expecting something to leap out at all of you without warning. Really, you haven't even reached the catacombs yet and she's already acting so jumpy. [flags.ARONA_TOTEM |Besides, what's there to be afraid of now that she can smack ghosts like any other foe? If anything, they should be the ones afraid of her. "Hey, just because you can fight back doesn't mean you don't have to stay on your toes." Arona? Showing caution and prudence when it comes to fighting foes? That's most unlike her. If she keeps up this pretense, someone might actually imagine that she's genuinely afraid. Wouldn't that be awful for the image of a big, strong orc like her. "J-just shut up already, you! Lumia's tits, seriously. I don't know why I let you drag me around on these trips of yours." Because she gets to meet all sorts of interesting people and fight them, like what you're doing now. "Ghosts aren't people, you dumbass!" Then what are they? "Ghosts!" |If she keeps acting like this, someone might get the wrong idea and think that she's afraid of ghosts. "I ain't afraid of no ghost, buster. I'm just... aware that there's not fucking much I can do on this stupid trip of yours. Like, what am I even supposed to do against a slime? Splat it? It'll just flow back together again! And ghosts? Come on, you can't seriously expect me to hit those! Once again, why the fuck did you even bring me here? It's not like you didn't know what to expect going in, right?" Please, she really needs to take a breath before she passes out or attracts all the goos in the courtyard with the yelling she's doing. "Fuck." Arona heaves a sigh and stares at you accusatory. "Once more, why'd you even bother dragging me along, anyway? You know my [arona.weapon] isn't going to do shit against anything in there, right?" Sure, but she's big and meaty and can put herself in between you and danger. That's her most prominent attribute, isn't it? Big... and meaty. Arona chuckles dryly. "You don't have to flatter me, asshole, I'm already here. Although if you do really want to show your appreciation, presenting your ass for me after we're through with this would be a good start." ] |"I don't like this place," Azyrran mutters, looking around with her big black eyes and [azyrran.weapon] at the ready. "It gives me the creeps." Is she afraid, then? "No, I'm not afraid, but that doesn't mean I have to like this sepulcher all the same. It's a place of parting, of goodbyes, and while I know it's inevitable someday it's also not something I'm ready for just yet." Especially when she came so close to it before. "The day will come when I won't be with my mother and sisters anymore, [pc.name]. Either that, or I'll be the first to go. But for now, that day's comfortably ahead of us all, thanks to you... and not something I want to give too much thought to here and now." |"Hmph," Quin snorts as he tiptoes alongside you through the courtyard. "Another of these places. The imps and slimes really did a number on the place, didn't they? It can't have been that long since I fucked off from Tollus and his posse... even if all this shit went down immediately after, which I doubt, this place looks like it's been abandoned for years. Trust me, that kind of feel doesn't come easily." He'd know, would he? "Before all this happened, it was pretty common for Tollus to scrounge around places like this — sometimes, he'd get so excited that he'd join in the excavations himself. That, or he was so much of a mistrustful bastard that he worried his underlings would hide any important finds from him. But yeah, I got to see a whole bunch of places like these over a couple of years — abandoned, overgrown, half-buried, once you've seen enough of them they all just kind of blend into each other, especially when more than half have been picked clean or everything's rotted away already. Them's the breaks, I guess." |"An interesting design," Kiyoko muses, looking around her. "The sturdy nature of the structure belies its purpose — it reminds me of the kirin vaults where the dedicants of the goddess keep their... things. But this is a vault for the dead, and not one of treasures; they are already restless, and we should tread lightly." Much call for graveyards in her homeland? "Less than here. Cremation is also an acceptable method of dealing with the dead, cheaper and more... ah, compact. By the way your priestess friend described the catacombs both attached to the temple and under the grand city of Khor'minos itself, she gave the impression that this mountain is filled to the brim with the bones of its inhabitants past. It is a somber and humbling thought all at once, and the architecture of a people speaks volumes about them." |"Oh wow," Atugia muses quietly, looking about her. "It's very heavy and dark. Kind of reminds me of Carmen's place, when you get down to it. Not just the color of the stone, but also the sense of weight to it, like it's trying to crush you just for staring at the walls too hard." Now that Atugia's pointing it out... yeah, you can kind of see the similarity between the Tiran temple and Castle Hawkstone. It's unlikely that the builders of both were one and the same, but you can see the architectural influences one had on the other. Does she know if the baroness contracted minotaurs to put up the castle? "Dunno, that was before my time. Or before Carmen's time too, to be honest. Her father might've been the one to have the castle built, or it might've been her grandfather... maybe I oughta have paid more attention when she was telling me all this stuff. But given that they really know how to give a building feel, it wouldn't surprise me if it really was cow-people who laid the foundations of Castle Hawkstone." |As all of you creep through the shadows of the courtyard, you can't help but catch Ryn eyeing the Tiran temple — sealed shut as it is, the structure nevertheless looks all the more imposing for you being up close. Penny for her thoughts? "Oh no, it's nothing. I was just thinking... I was just thinking how similar this looked like the crypts beneath the palace. It's got that same weighty feel to it, doesn't it?" Well, that's where you've got to disagree with her. These may both be resting places of the dead, but when one's dedicated to Lumia and the other to Tira, the atmosphere is bound to be different, and not just because adherents of either goddess have pretty different views on just about every aspect of death. You're not chiding her or anything, but it might be worth thinking on. Ryn's quiet for the rest of the trip through the courtyard, clearly reflecting on what you've just said. ] Eventually, Nihara leads you around the side of the temple to a wall in the back where its joins into the natural tunnel, brushing aside several pieces of fallen debris to reveal a stairwell leading downwards. The air's a bit stale, but still breathable, and whitefire flares up on the tip of her staff, lighting your way as you make the descent. While chills run down the back of your neck, no spectres or slime show up to accost you — yet — and you're able to reach the bottom landing unmolested. "All right, I'll open up the catacombs. A moment, please." Indeed, set in the northern wall is an enormous granite door with the symbol of a moon-etched hourglass set into the dark rock. As Nihara steps up and presses her hand squarely into the middle of the crescent moon, golden lines flow outward from her palm to fill in the hourglass — with a faint rumble and outward puff of stale air, the doors swing open, showing you the way into the pitch-black catacombs ahead. Even from here, you can see lines upon lines of recesses in the rock walls, filled to the brim with big, bovine bones; there're crystal holders for lights, but it's been a long while since any of them have been replaced and it's all gone dark. rows.original:
The both of you pass from the sitting room and head out to the bathing pool, where Nihara gives you a small bow before drawing close, close enough for the fullness of her curvaceous body to impress upon your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. The two of you disrobe each other, her fingers picking apart your [pc.armor] with ease, and then smooth as silk, she urges you beneath the water's surface. It should be cold, but the waves lapping across the lake's surface are no more than a little chilly as Nihara drapes herself across you and coils her two goo-tails about your legs.
    
    There, however, the familiarity ends. Flowing around behind you, Nihara gently hooks her arms under your shoulders and guides you away from the stone steps, out the bathing pool and away from her home. [pc.heightRange 68 84
        |You fit perfectly in her embrace, sinking against her and being reminded that she's the perfect mix of goo and cat with all the best qualities of both. The rise and fall of her chest against your back is less that of breathing and more that of flowing and undulating as she carries the both of you out into the lake's [nihara.isCorrupted
            |calm, dark middle, clinging onto you with arms and hair alike as if afraid to lose you. All's still save for the soft lap of waves against your shoulders and the workings of your goocat's body, [nihara.isPregnant
                |most of all the heaving of her big, kitten filled tummy as it presses into your back
                |one with the lake as she settles into her element
            ].
            
            "Just for one, to be able to bring you out here," she purrs, moving to brush your cheek. "If it were up to me, we would be here forever... but forever's a long time, and the goddess has other plans for both you and I."
            
            Nihara wraps her arms about you, and there's a calming sensation of comfort as you unknowingly drive home just how well-suited your bodies are for each other. The contrast between the dark lake and the luminescent shore, between the yawning depths of the lake and the glinting shards far above that could be mistaken for stars... it's a relationship akin, though not exactly the same, to that...
            |heart, a trail of glimmering motes in your wake. It feels like the lake's more active than usual, currents tugging at your fingers and toes, but where Nihara holds you the water's still about her curvaceous figure. [nihara.isPregnant
                |With how kitten-filled she is, there's a lot of your goocat to go around
                |It's a calming scene despite the constant teasing and tugging
            ], and she takes clear delight in being the center of attention while your surroundings set the mood for this little tryst she has in mind.
            
            "This is so much better than being indoors, isn't it?"
            
            It...is, especially with the glinting shards in the cavern ceiling far above, the same shade of azure as the lake itself. She wasn't wrong, the scene does set the mood. Although there's no lack of light from the azure motes that flicker into existence in your wake, it's impossible to see the bottom from where you are. The lake is like its mistress: bright and transparent, yet inscrutable in its depths, and maybe just a little smug about it.
        ]
        |You may be taller than she is, but your goocat's in her element and with the lake's waters buoying you up Nihara manages to handle the both of you just fine. By degrees, she floats the both of you out into the lake's [nihara.isCorrupted
            |deep, dark middle, clinging onto you with arms and hair alike as if afraid to lose you.
            
            And... she probably is. In all of this inky, perhaps even viscous water devoid of light and as bottomless as any abyss, there's a feeling of comfort as Nihara entwines her voluptuous form about you as best as she can, keeping the both of you buoyed.
            
            The contrast between the dark lake and the luminescent shore, between the yawning depths of the lake and the glinting shards far above that could be mistaken for stars... Nihara was right when she said she needed to set the proper mood.
            |vast expanse, clinging onto you with arms and hair alike as if afraid to lose you.

                |But I daresay I've spent long enough lugging around heavy weights that I'm used to it."
                
                What does she —
                
                Nihara replies by way of thrusting the firm dome of her kitten-swollen belly into your back, which is answer enough. Oh.
                |Then again, I've handled heavier, more troublesome people in my time."
                
                Oh.

The lake is like its mistress: bright and transparent, yet inscrutable in its depths, and maybe just a little smug about it.

Nihara may not be telling, but she's certainly not wrong that she needed to set the mood for whatever she intends to discuss.

        |deep, dark middle, the waves lapping against the both of you feeling more like ink than water in both color and consistency. Yet in all this, there's comfort — a sense of restful concealment, for lack of a better word to put it, full-bodied and voluptuous in its heavy flow

        |中间，那些微小的光点闪烁着出现，为你前行的道路照亮道路。虽然这片湖什么都不隐藏，但事实依然是，它深得令人难以置信，当波浪拍打着你的脸颊和四肢时，水带给你的感觉比想象中要沉重得多。

毫无疑问，这就是活水——实在没有更好的词语来形容它了。
    ]那片长满闪烁着微轻型蘑菇的海岸，看起来实在是遥不可及……尼原并没有开玩笑，真正只有你们两个人而已。
rows.raw:
"
    The both of you pass from the sitting room and head out to the bathing pool, where Nihara gives you a small bow before drawing close, close enough for the fullness of her curvaceous body to impress upon your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. The two of you disrobe each other, her fingers picking apart your [pc.armor] with ease, and then smooth as silk, she urges you beneath the water's surface. It should be cold, but the waves lapping across the lake's surface are no more than a little chilly as Nihara drapes herself across you and coils her two goo-tails about your legs.
    
    There, however, the familiarity ends. Flowing around behind you, Nihara gently hooks her arms under your shoulders and guides you away from the stone steps, out the bathing pool and away from her home. [pc.heightRange 68 84
        |You fit perfectly in her embrace, sinking against her and being reminded that she's the perfect mix of goo and cat with all the best qualities of both. The rise and fall of her chest against your back is less that of breathing and more that of flowing and undulating as she carries the both of you out into the lake's [nihara.isCorrupted
            |calm, dark middle, clinging onto you with arms and hair alike as if afraid to lose you. All's still save for the soft lap of waves against your shoulders and the workings of your goocat's body, [nihara.isPregnant
                |most of all the heaving of her big, kitten filled tummy as it presses into your back
                |one with the lake as she settles into her element
            ].
            
            "Just for one, to be able to bring you out here," she purrs, moving to brush your cheek. "If it were up to me, we would be here forever... but forever's a long time, and the goddess has other plans for both you and I."
            
            Nihara wraps her arms about you, and there's a calming sensation of comfort as you unknowingly drive home just how well-suited your bodies are for each other. The contrast between the dark lake and the luminescent shore, between the yawning depths of the lake and the glinting shards far above that could be mistaken for stars... it's a relationship akin, though not exactly the same, to that...
            |heart, a trail of glimmering motes in your wake. It feels like the lake's more active than usual, currents tugging at your fingers and toes, but where Nihara holds you the water's still about her curvaceous figure. [nihara.isPregnant
                |With how kitten-filled she is, there's a lot of your goocat to go around
                |It's a calming scene despite the constant teasing and tugging
            ], and she takes clear delight in being the center of attention while your surroundings set the mood for this little tryst she has in mind.
            
            "This is so much better than being indoors, isn't it?"
            
            It...is, especially with the glinting shards in the cavern ceiling far above, the same shade of azure as the lake itself. She wasn't wrong, the scene does set the mood. Although there's no lack of light from the azure motes that flicker into existence in your wake, it's impossible to see the bottom from where you are. The lake is like its mistress: bright and transparent, yet inscrutable in its depths, and maybe just a little smug about it.
        ]
        |You may be taller than she is, but your goocat's in her element and with the lake's waters buoying you up Nihara manages to handle the both of you just fine. By degrees, she floats the both of you out into the lake's [nihara.isCorrupted
            |deep, dark middle, clinging onto you with arms and hair alike as if afraid to lose you.
            
            And... she probably is. You get the feeling that if nothing else mattered but her desires, Nihara would be sorely tempted to keep you here forever, but as a Tiran priestess she's well aware of there being more to the world than just her. In all of this inky, perhaps even viscous water devoid of light and as bottomless as any abyss, there's a feeling of comfort as Nihara entwines her voluptuous form about you as best as she can, keeping the both of you buoyed.
            
            The contrast between the dark lake and the luminescent shore, between the yawning depths of the lake and the glinting shards far above that could be mistaken for stars... Nihara was right when she said she needed to set the proper mood.
            |vast expanse, clinging onto you with arms and hair alike as if afraid to lose you.
            
            Is she okay holding you like this? She may have bitten off more than she can chew.
            
            "Oof, you're heavy, I won't deny that." Her giggle is forced, but at least she's not struggling. "[nihara.isPregnant
                |But I daresay I've spent long enough lugging around heavy weights that I'm used to it."
                
                What does she —
                
                Nihara replies by way of thrusting the firm dome of her kitten-swollen belly into your back, which is answer enough. Oh.
                |Then again, I've handled heavier, more troublesome people in my time."
                
                Oh.
            ]
            
            Although there's no lack of light from the azure motes that flicker into existence in your wake, it's impossible to see the bottom from where you are. The lake is like its mistress: bright and transparent, yet inscrutable in its depths, and maybe just a little smug about it.
            
            The lake's luminescent life... all the mushroom-trees and other fungi that ring its shores draw moisture from it and glow with the same color; one wonders if the shards so high in the cave ceiling have a similar origin. Nihara may not be telling, but she's certainly not wrong that she needed to set the mood for whatever she intends to discuss.
        ]
        |She's so much taller than you that taking you into her embrace is easy; the trip out into the lake is soothing as you simply have to leave everything to Nihara while she coddles you
    ]. By degrees, Nihara floats the both of you out into the lake's [nihara.isCorrupted
        |deep, dark middle, the waves lapping against the both of you feeling more like ink than water in both color and consistency. Yet in all this, there's comfort — a sense of restful concealment, for lack of a better word to put it, full-bodied and voluptuous in its heavy flow
        |middle, tiny motes of light flickering into existence to illuminate your passing. Although the lake hides nothing from you, the fact remains that it's oh-so-very deep, and the water feels heavier than it ought to as waves lap about your cheeks and limbs.
        
        Without a doubt, this is living water, for lack of a better phrase to describe it
    ]. The shore with its glimmering mushrooms seems so very far away... Nihara wasn't kidding, it's just the two of you.
    "

rows.original: For a while, the both of you float upon the lake, Nihara buoying you with her hands clasped over your middle and bosom cushioning your back[nihara.gigamilk | — and what a cushion it is, too, given how much her girls have developed ]. Your goocat clings to you with her more watery extremities, caressing away gently and spreading a calming coolness through the core of your being while the both of you take in the %"star"-studded ceiling. "[pc.name]," she says at last. Yes. You'd been enjoying the moment, but that isn't why the both of you came out here. About what she wanted to discuss... the future you had together, right? "There's no need to sound so worried," Nihara [nihara.isCorrupted |purrs[pc.hasEmoteEars |, craning her neck to nibble on one of your ears from the side ]. "I'm not going to demand that you march me right down the streets of Khor'minos and to the Pantheon, marry me on the spot, and settle down with me to be [pc.mf |father |mother ] to our kittens for the rest of your days. It's crossed my mind several times and is quite the arousing fantasy, but it's not your time and frankly, neither is it mine. Perhaps someday when we've fulfilled our roles the goddess has for us, but not before then." Nihara swishes her tails in the water before briefly wrapping them about your ankles, and in that moment you're aware of just how lightless the lake is, how unyielding its depths are. It could swallow you up in an instant, and you'd never be found... But that sense of danger is what draws you to the lake and its lady, isn't it? That she could do such things were her senses to leave her, and yet she doesn't? "We can't always have what we want, my dear [pc.name]. I have duties to those who stubbornly remain out in the tunnels, and you have a destiny to fulfill. That, and we have kittens[nihara.isPregnant |, with yet another litter on the way ]." She sounds pretty pleased with herself at that. "I just wish to remind you that you'll always have a place in this lake to come back to, to call home, with a cat and kittens waiting for you. I'll always be here to welcome you with open arms — and full boobs, given how [nihara.gigamilk |you went to all the trouble getting me these |you seem to love them so much ]. And after you're done with this destiny that she's so convinced her goddess has in store for you? Would she prefer it if you stayed with her? Nihara shivers at that, a violent tremble that's palpable even to you, [nihara.isPregnant |even her kitten-filled womb tightening with perverse delight at the prospect |her fingers tightening about your person and pulling you close ]. "I get wet just thinking about it, my dear [pc.name]. More than usual given what I am, anyway," she whispers into your ear. "Please don't tease me when I've just bared my dear, vulnerable heart to you, or else I might just do something I regret. |sighs, hugging you a little closer. "It's not our time for an ending just yet, and if we don't work hard enough there's no guarantee from the goddess that it'll be a happy one. Besides, there's no point in demanding that you march me right down the streets of Khor'minos to the Pantheon and marry me on the spot. It'd change nothing, because everything meaningful is already right here with me, wouldn't you say?" Yes, but... that last bit of hers is oddly specific. "Just an idle fantasy, little more. Even in better times, I didn't go to the city that much... I'd everything I needed by the lake, and being away from home for long tires me out. This used to be a rich locale, after all, where the wealthy would come to get away from the dirt and bustle of Khor'minos proper. "And there are still people out there who need me, and the same goes for you. This is no time for either of us to retreat from the world and become hermits just for each other. Tira has a destiny for you to fulfill, and before that's accomplished..." You sigh and lean a little more into Nihara's voluptuous, motherly body, squishing her a little more like the goocat she is. She giggles and sighs, toying with your [pc.hair] as the both of you float a little longer. "Well, there's that, and we have kittens[nihara.isPregnant |, with yet another litter on the way ]. I just want to remind you that you'll always have a place in this lake to come back to, to call home, with a cat and kittens waiting for you. I'll always be here to welcome you with open arms... and more, should you desire it." It's nothing that she hasn't been doing already, but you're grateful nonetheless. And after you're done with this destiny that she's so convinced her goddess has in store for you? Would she prefer it if you stayed with her? Nihara sighs and curls her tails about your legs, pulling you in against her[nihara.isPregnant | big, kitten-filled belly, huge and trembling as it is ]. "If the goddess were to take you from me tomorrow, [pc.name], it would have been an experience worth having already. Though I can always hope and pray, it's also not done to ask for too much. ] "That being said, I think I've gone on long enough. How about you, [pc.name]? What do you think about our future?"
rows.translation: 有那么一段时间，你们俩漂浮在湖面上，尼哈拉双手部托着你的腰部，而她的胸膛则轻轻垫在你的背后。[nihara.gigamilk | ——而且，考虑到她的孩子们已经取得了如此大的进步，这确实是一个很好的缓冲。 ]你的小猫用它那柔软的四肢紧紧依偎在你身边，轻轻抚摸着你，带来一种令人宁静的清凉感，仿佛直达你的心灵深处。而你们俩一起凝视着那布满星星的天花板。[pc.name]终于，她开口说道。 “是的。你们之前确实一直在享受这个时刻，但你们来到这里的目的并不是为了这个。关于她想要讨论的事情……关于你们共同的未来，对吧？ “没有必要表现得那么担心，”尼原说道。 [nihara.isCorrupted |发出呼噜声[pc.hasEmoteEars |她伸长脖子，从侧面轻轻咬了你的耳朵一下。 ]我并不要求你一定要带我穿过科尔米诺斯的街道，去到七神，在那里立刻与我结婚，然后和我一起安定下来生活…… [pc.mf |父亲 |母亲 ] 在你余生的每一天里，都与我们这些小猫一起度过吧。这个想法已经在我脑海中出现过好几次了…… 是 这确实是一个令人兴奋的幻想，但现在还不是你的时机，坦白说，对我来说也不是。也许有一天，当我们完成了女神赋予我们的使命之后，就会实现这个愿望，但在那之前还不是时候。 尼哈拉在水中摆动着尾巴，然后短暂地将尾巴缠在你的脚踝上。就在那一刻，你才意识到这片湖泊是多么的幽暗，它的深处又是多么的深不可测。 它能在瞬间将你吞没，而你永远也不会被找到…… 但正是这种危险感，才吸引你前往那片湖泊以及它的“主人”，不是吗？正是这种危险感让她的感官产生了警觉，但她却并没有因此而远离…… 亲爱的，我们并不能总是得到自己想要的东西。 [pc.name]我对那些坚持留在隧道里的人们负有责任，而你也有自己的使命需要完成。除此之外，我们还有小猫需要照顾呢。[nihara.isPregnant |又有一窝小动物即将诞生了。 ]听她这么说，似乎对自己挺满意的呢。我只是想提醒你，这个地方永远为你敞开怀抱，这里有猫和小猫在等着你，这里永远是你可以回归的家园。我会一直在这里，用双臂热情地欢迎你——当然，如果我的胸部够大的话，那就更完美了…… [nihara.gigamilk |你费了那么大劲才为我搞到这些。 |你似乎非常喜欢它们。 ]那么，当你完成了她坚信自己的女神为你安排的那段命运之后，她还会希望你继续留在她身边吗？ 尼哈拉听到这个问题后不禁浑身发抖，那种剧烈的颤抖甚至连你都能清晰地感受到。 [nihara.isPregnant |就连她那怀有无数小猫的子宫，也在想到这一幕时，不由自主地因为一种怪异的愉悦感而收紧起来。 |她的手指紧紧抓住你的身体，将你拉得更近。 ]光是想到这个我就觉得浑身都湿透了，亲爱的…… [pc.name]考虑到我的身份，这种情况其实比平时更为罕见，”她在你耳边轻声说道，“请不要在我刚刚向你敞开了自己脆弱的心扉时取笑我，否则我可能会做出一些让自己后悔的事情。 |她叹了口气，把你的手部臂搂得更紧了一些：“现在还不是我们结束这段关系的时候，如果我们不够努力，女神也无法保证我们的结局会是幸福的。更何况，要求你立刻带我去科尔米诺斯的街道上，去七神里立刻和我结婚，这也太不现实了。 那也不会改变什么，因为所有重要的东西都已经在我身边了，你不觉得吗？” “是的，但是……她最后说的那句话有点奇怪，显得特别具体。” “不过也只是个闲暇时的幻想罢了，没什么特别的。 即使在最好的时候，我也很少去城里……我在湖边就能得到我需要的一切，而且长时间离开家会让我感到疲惫。毕竟，这里曾经是一个富饶的地方，富人们会来到这里，远离科尔米诺斯城区的喧嚣与尘嚣。 这个世界上仍然有人需要我，你也是如此。现在不是我们中的任何一个人为了对方而远离世界、隐居起来的时候。蒂拉有一项使命需要你去完成，在那之前…………” 你叹了口气，更加紧紧地依偎在尼哈拉那丰满而充满母性关怀的身体上，把她紧紧地搂在怀里，就像抱着一只可爱的小猫一样。她咯咯笑着，也轻轻叹了口气，似乎在和你闹着玩。 [pc.hair] 当你们俩继续漂浮一会儿的时候…… “嗯，就是这个了，而且我们还有小猫呢。[nihara.isPregnant |又有一窝幼崽即将出生了。 ]我只是想提醒你，这个湖边永远有一个属于你的地方，你可以随时回到这里，把它当作自己的家——那里有猫和小猫在等着你。我会一直在这里，张开双臂欢迎你的归来……当然，如果你有更多的需求，我也愿意为你提供帮助。这其实并不是她没有做过的事情，但你依然心怀感激。那么，当你完成了她坚信自己的女神为你安排的那段命运之后，她还会希望你继续留在她身边吗？ 尼原叹了口气，把尾巴缠在你的腿上，将你拉向自己身边。[nihara.isPregnant | 那个肚子又大又圆，里面装满了小猫，看起来既庞大又一直在颤抖。 ]如果明天女神将你从我身边带走…… [pc.name]这样的经历本身就已经非常值得了。虽然我总是可以抱有希望并为之祈祷，但要求也确实不能太高。 ] 话虽如此，我觉得我已经说得太多了。你呢？ [pc.name]你对我们未来的发展有什么看法？

rows.original: It has to be dangerous out here now that everyone's gone. Perhaps she and the kittens would be safer at the wayfort.
rows.translation: 现在大家都走了，这里肯定很危险。也许她和那些小猫在路标处会更安全些。
rows.raw: "It has to be dangerous out here now that everyone's gone. Perhaps she and the kittens would be safer at the wayfort."

rows.translation: 那些小猫的未来该怎么办呢？

rows.original: Despite everything else that's been going on in the tunnels, the lake's pretty calm. She and the kittens will be fine, you take it?
rows.translation: 尽管隧道里发生了那么多事情，这个湖依然非常平静。她和那些小猫们一定会没事的，你相信我吧？
rows.raw: "Despite everything else that's been going on in the tunnels, the lake's pretty calm. She and the kittens will be fine, you take it?"

rows.original: You're done talking for now. Perhaps it's best that the both of you enjoy each others' company in the time you have left.
rows.translation: 你现在可以停止说话了。或许，在剩下的时间里，你们俩一起享受彼此的陪伴才是最好的选择。
rows.raw: "You're done talking for now. Perhaps it's best that the both of you enjoy each others' company in the time you have left."

rows.original: Nihara gives you a small, sad smile. "I'm afraid that's not possible, [pc.name]." You'd expected an answer along these lines, but why not, though? If it's just about needing to live in water, there's the River Ridell just by the fort, and as far as you know there aren't any elementals calling it their home. "Oh, [pc.name]. If it were just about needing to live in water, Khor'minos has no lack of pools, fountains, aqueducts, baths and more. The Pantheon has a particularly fine garden I visited once. If I could take refuge within the city walls like so many others have done, I'd certainly be welcome there despite my low station as a priestess. "The thing is... I am the lake now. A water wyrd who settles in a body of water becomes, over time, one with it; what happens to me happens to the lake, and the reverse is true as well. For better or for worse, I must remain; it makes no sense to separate me from myself. Far to the south in Yvennes, in the duchy of Clairemont, there's a tale of a lady of the lake who hands out swords to would-be royals. That one's certainly one of my kin. "But I digress. [pc.name]... there's nothing wrong with a river; for you, I'd live in a pond or well. But having made my choice, I can't leave, not even if you decanted the entire lake as-is and poured it into your river. It's more than just the water in it, as our surroundings should make clear enough." ...There's nothing to be done, then? A smile. "There's always something to be done. We can be with each other here, spend what time we're permitted to have with each other before the inevitable departure. Worry less about what cannot be, so that we don't forget to enjoy what we have. Basic Tiran philosophy, or at least of my particular school. "I'm the lady of this lake, my dear [pc.name]. I've put my roots down here, and for a water wyrd, that's a binding commitment. There are those who never choose to make such a heavy decision, but I have, and I'm bound to these waters for the rest of my life." ...[pc.isDK |It's hard to understand why someone would give up one's freedom like that |You may not understand fully, but Nihara isn't the type to make such decisions lightly ]. "We have our reasons." Then... if not her, what about the kittens? "They'll come to no harm so long as they stay inside the lake. I'll make sure of that. Perhaps in the years to come, some of them will want to come and live in that river by your wayfort, and that would be a fine thing. For now, though, they're too young for that." ...So, there's nothing you can do about their situation. "There's plenty you can do, [pc.name]. It just doesn't involve uprooting us from where we are, well-intentioned as it may be. Not to impugn your abilities, but right now this lake may be the safest place in all of the Marches for us." Nihara leans in over your shoulder and kisses you lightly on the cheek. "Don't worry. "Now, is there anything else you wanted to discuss on your end?"
rows.translation: 尼原露出一个淡淡的、略带悲伤的微笑：“恐怕这是不可能的。 [pc.name]你本以为会得到这样的回答，但为什么不会呢？如果只是因为需要生活在水中，那么堡垒旁边就有里德尔河，而且据你所知，也没有任何元素生物将那里作为自己的家园。 “哦， [pc.name]如果仅仅是因为需要生活在水中，那么科尔米诺斯城其实并不缺乏池塘、喷泉、引水渠、浴场等等设施。七神里还有一个特别漂亮的花园，我曾经去参观过。如果我能像许多其他人一样躲在城墙之内，那么尽管我只是个低阶的女祭司，我也一定会受到欢迎的。 “问题在于…… 是 现在的这片湖泊也是如此。那些栖息在水中的水之精灵，会随着时间的流逝与水域融为一体；我所经历的一切，也会发生在这片湖泊身上，反之亦然。无论结果是好是坏，我都必须留在这里；将自己与这片湖泊分开，是没有意义的。在遥远的南方，伊文尼斯地区的克莱尔蒙特公国，有一个关于湖中女神会将剑赐予那些有成为王室成员潜质之人的故事……那位女神，无疑也是我的同族。 “不过，我有点跑题了…… [pc.name]……河流本身并没有什么不妥；对你来说，我甚至愿意住在池塘或井里。但既然我已经做出了选择，我就不能再改变了，即使你把整个湖泊的原貌原封不动地倒入你的河流里也是如此。因为这里的意义并不仅仅在于水本身，我们的周围环境应该已经足够清楚地说明了这一点。……那么，就没什么办法了吗？ 她微笑着回答：“总会有办法的。我们可以在这里陪伴彼此，珍惜这段在分离来临之前能够共度的时光。 不要过分担心那些无法实现的事情，这样我们就不会忘记去享受自己已经拥有的一切。这是提兰的基本哲学，至少是我所在派别的哲学。 “我是……的女士。 这个 亲爱的，那就是湖泊。 [pc.name]我在这里安下了根，对于一个水之精灵来说，这是一个不可违背的承诺。有些人永远不会选择做出这样的决定，但我选择了，因此余生我都将与这些水域紧密相连。[pc.isDK |很难理解为什么有人会那样放弃自己的自由。 |你可能还不完全明白，但尼原并不是那种会轻易做出这种决定的人。 ]我们自有我们的理由。” 那么……如果不是她，那些小猫怎么办呢？ “只要它们待在湖里，就不会受到任何伤害。我会确保这一点的。也许在未来几年里，其中一些小猫会想要来到你家附近的那条河里生活，那当然是一件好事。不过目前来说，它们还太年轻了，还不适合这样做。” ……所以，对于它们的处境，你无能为力。 “其实你可以做很多事情的…… [pc.name]这并不会让我们离开我们现在所在的地方，无论这些意图是多么良善。我并不是要质疑你的能力，但目前来说，这个湖泊可能是整个边境地区对我们来说最安全的地方。”尼原凑到你的肩旁，轻轻吻了吻你的脸颊。“别担心。” “那么，你还有什么其他事情想要讨论的吗？

rows.original:
"Thinking of the future already, [pc.name]? It'll be decades before any of them are ready to fly the nest[pc.ra lupine orc
        |. You might be pretty old by then, if not... never mind
    ]."
    
    [wayfort.hasKari
        |Right. You remember Kari and how long she's lived as a hellhound; it makes sense that another people who's been similarly elementally infused enjoy such longevity too... at a cost. 
    ]Isn't there an old saying along the lines of planting trees of which the shade you'll never sit in?
    
    A smile and warm caress. "There is that, I suppose. It's just... the elemental heritage of me and my kind, that's all. People associate goofolk with quick lives, but despite the similarities water wyrds aren't goos in the same sense that people think of them. You don't need to worry about anything — the kittens will stay with me until they're old enough, and then someday they'll leave me as I did my parents, travel away from this lake, and find a body of water to call home.
    
    "Maybe it'll be a river, maybe it'll be a lake, maybe it'll be down by the coast or in a lightless sea trench. Where our kittens choose to put down roots, only the goddess knows; she'll guide them to their fates when the time comes. On my part, I can only mind them and keep them safe within my lake, and on yours... you can make the world just a little bit better for when they have to venture out into it."
    
    Perhaps one of them will take up residence in the River Ridell, by the wayfort.
    
    "Maybe. They're very young for water wyrds, little more than bundles of hunger and instinct... as a mother, it's my job to keep them fed, corralled and give them a safe place to play in. It'll be a few years before they'll be old enough for us to do anything meaningful with them, I'm afraid.
    
    "But hopefully by then all this demon nonsense will have died down and people will be coming back to this part of the undermountain. Now won't that be a treat!"
rows.translation:
已经开始考虑未来了， [pc.name]? 要过几十年，它们中的任何一种才能真正开始独立生活。[pc.ra lupine orc
        |到那时，你可能已经年纪不小了……不过，算了，也不必太在意。
    ]."
    
    [wayfort.hasKari
        |没错。你还记得卡莉，以及她作为地狱犬生活了多久吧；那么，那些同样被赋予了元素力量的人也能拥有如此漫长的寿命，这也是合情合理的……只不过，这一切都需要付出相应的代价。 
    ]不是有句古话说的吗，种下的树最终形成的荫凉，自己是永远也享受不到的？

她微笑着，温柔地抚摸着他的头发：“我想，确实是这样的。只不过……这只是我和我们这一族与生俱来的特性罢了。 人们常常认为那些傻乎乎的生物寿命短暂，但实际上，水生生物与人们所想象中的那些“傻瓜”并不相同。你完全不必担心什么——那些小猫会一直跟着我，直到它们长大到可以独立生活的程度。然后，就像我离开我的父母一样，它们也会离开我，离开这个湖泊，去寻找属于自己的家园。
    
    也许会变成一条河流，也许会变成一个湖泊，也许会出现在海岸边，或者是在一片无光的海洋沟壑中。我们的小猫们会选择在何处安家落户，只有女神才知道；当那一刻来临时，她会引导它们走向各自的命运。至于我，所能做的就是守护它们，让它们在我的湖泊里平安成长；而你……你可以让这个世界变得稍微美好一些，这样当它们不得不走出去面对这个世界时，至少会有一个更好的环境。
    
    也许其中某一只会定居在里德尔河附近的堡垒附近吧。

“也许吧。对于那些水生生物来说，它们还太年轻了，现在还只是一群充满饥饿感与本能的幼崽……作为母亲，我的职责就是确保它们有食物吃，把它们圈起来，为它们提供一个安全的地方让它们玩耍。恐怕还要等上几年，它们才会长大到可以让我们真正利用它们来做一些有意义的事情。
    
    但希望到那时，所有这些关于恶魔的闹剧都已经平息，人们也能重新回到地底山的这一区域。那该有多好啊！

rows.original:
Nihara sighs and holds you a little tighter. "I'm the lady of this lake, [pc.name]. Within its boundaries, I've absolute power... perhaps even moreso after meeting you, because I have others to live for now. To be sure, it's not impossible that I could be overwhelmed, but it's the same way it's not impossible the city could be overwhelmed, right?
    
    "We are as safe as it's possible to be, so worrying about us is pointless. I can't leave the lake for long, so it's up to you to take the fight to those who would threaten us."
    
    It's more than just Nihara and the kittens' physical safety. Were these more peaceful times, the tunnels would be clearer and people would be living by the lake... the most Nihara might hope to see on a regular basis are legionnaire patrols.
    
    "And the ferryman. Don't forget him." Nihara sighs. "But the fact that he still stubbornly plies his trade despite having no one to ferry is testament to how safe I can keep the lake... that and how stubborn and set in his ways he is. But in a way, he is a hope that things will return to normal someday."
    
    You sigh.
    
    Nihara hugs you close and leans in to kiss you on the cheek. "Well, if you want the situation to resolve all the quicker, then you've got to work harder, don't you think?"
    
    All right, if she's confident in her power to hold off any threats to herself and the kittens while you're gone, you'll trust her on that.
    
    "Like I said, we both have more than ourselves to live for. I can't explain it myself, but of late I've been feeling ever stronger than before, and I'm sure it's because of that... I'd had similar feelings before when tending to the people who lived around here, but never this intense. Thank you for that, [pc.name]."
rows.translation:
尼原叹了口气，然后将你抱得更紧了一些。“我是这片湖泊的女主人…… [pc.name]在这个范围内，我拥有绝对的权力……或许在遇见你之后，这种权力甚至会更加强大，因为现在我还有其他人需要守护。当然，我也有可能被压倒，但同样的，这座城市也有可能遭遇同样的命运，对吧？
    
    我们已经采取了所有可能的安全措施，所以担心我们是没有必要的。我无法长时间离开这个湖泊，因此阻止那些想要威胁我们的人的责任就落在了你们身上。”

这不仅仅关乎尼哈拉和小猫们的生命安全。如果现在是一个更加和平的时代，这些隧道也会被清理得更加通畅，人们也会在湖泊附近生活……对于尼哈拉来说，她最希望看到的，或许也就是军团士兵的巡逻罢了。
    
    还有那个摆渡人，别忘了他。”尼原叹了口气，“尽管已经没有人需要他摆渡了，但他仍然坚持着自己的工作，这一事实恰恰证明了我的湖泊是多么安全……同时也说明了他是多么固执、多么坚持自己的习惯。但从某种意义上来说，他也是我们期待有一天一切能恢复正常的希望。
    
    你叹了口气。

尼原紧紧抱住你，然后凑过来亲了你的脸颊一下。“嗯，如果你想让事情尽快得到解决，那就得更加努力才行，不是吗？”

好吧，如果她对自己有能力在你不在的时候保护自己和那些小猫免受任何威胁充满信心，那么你当然应该信任她。
    
    正如我所说，我们两人都有更重要的事情需要去追求。我自己也很难解释这种感觉，但最近我发现自己比以前任何时候都更有力量，我相信这一切都是因为那个原因……以前在照顾这里的人们时，我也有过类似的感受，但从未像现在这样强烈。谢谢你，真的。 [pc.name]."
