If she's not proud of who she is, and she worries that her parents wouldn't be proud of the daughter that she raised... then she ought to do something about them. It's not too late to turn herself into a woman she knows her parents would be prideful of. Raizel lets out another sigh, this time through her mouth, and this time, it grinds against the inside of her throat in frustration. "It's that simple, is it?" she says, her gaze still askew. "Just strap on some boots and go make myself into something?" She turns her head towards you. The familiar, scowling expression you've known her for has returned, with her burning red eyes boring down into you from above. The glint of her teeth – and the tears in her eyes – have vanished. "Not every bully, asshole kid grows up to be the kind of person that recognizes that, sometimes, people are different," she says. "You let me know when there's room in the world for someone like me, [pc.name]." ]

rows.raw: ' Given the state of her living conditions, you take it you already know the answer to this one – but, hesitantly, you ask Raizel about her family, if she has any. It might be a sensitive topic. "Not a whole lot to tell," she answers. She leans back, propping one arm against the shelf holding her candle as she looks down at you with a furrowed brow and narrowed eyes. With an expression like that, she's telling you to choose your words carefully. "I'm a crossbreed between a pexighast and a veparus. My dad was the lizard and my mom was the snake. He liked the way she squeezed him and she liked the squeaks he made when she did it." She smirks wryly, leaning forward with her left hand to trace her index claw down your cheek. "You and he would have had something in common, [pc.name]." ... And does she have that in common with her mother? "Well, I haven't kicked you out," she says with a playful snort as she wrings her tail, squeezing you a bit. Not enough to hurt, but enough to push the air from your lungs in surprise. [rand |You yelp just slightly from the sudden force, and her smile widens, showing off the glint of her teeth in the candlelight |You don't make a sound, unfortunately for her: the air comes out as a soundless heaving gasp. Still, the wry smirk on her face doesn't yield ]. [raizel.affectionRange 0 21 |She leans back again, withdrawing her hand, and her expression hardens once more. "They died a while ago," she says matter-of-factly, as if she was talking about her lunch and not the death of her parents. "So. Not much of a safety net for me to fall back on." Maybe not from her parents, but does she have any extended family? Aunts, uncles, cousins...? "Not anywhere local," she answers. "And I'll be honest with you, [pc.name], I wouldn't recognize them if I ran into them in the street. I never really spent much time with my extended family." She leans forward, her tail squeezing onto you a little tighter as she does. "You know how difficult it is to spend time with your ‘loved ones' when one half of your family tree looks like one thing, and one half looks like another? And you don't fit into either?" You want to respond that that shouldn't matter to family. But... "Never mind when some of your family have... ‘less than pleasant' opinions for the other half of the tree," she continues. "Racist ol' Auntie Camellia on dad's side thought that purebred veparus were a fuckin' blight on the world. She hated mom. So when mom squeezes me out and I look just enough like her, but not enough like dad, well, that makes things a little awkward." ... What about her mother's side? "Wouldn't know," she answers. "Mom wasn't local either. She'd tell me stories, and all. She'd say that her half of the tree would have loved me. But not enough to come visit this frozen hellworld." She turns away from you, staring at the collapsed wall facing the road of the Undermountain, looking at nothing in particular. "I don't think they'd be able to help me out much, anyway. Mom and Dad weren't rich and I doubt anyone else in the tree was. A body like mine needs to eat a lot. I'd just be a burden on them, anyway." Then, silence, for an uncomfortably long time. Given the way she talks about her direct parents, she seemed to think of them with some affection. You ask her if she got along with them. She lets out a long sigh. Her eyes narrow further, and they arch downward, almost wistful. "Yeah," she answers after another long while, her voice even lower and quieter. "They were great." She stays that way for some time yet, stewing in her own thoughts, reminiscing about her past life. She clearly has no real love for at least one half of her family, but talking about her parents seems to lower her guard. Maybe she'd be willing to speak a bit more about them if you and her were more comfortable with each other. |Then, Raizel leans back, withdrawing her hand. The sly smirk on her face remains as her eyes drift away from yours, looking above you, staring into nothing. Her mind is clearly elsewhere. You wouldn't mind it, normally. Sometimes, people just aren't much talkers, and you like to think that you're good at listening. But, you were in the middle of a conversation. You ask Raizel if she's alright. At the sound of your voice, Raizel blinks a few times and shakes her head free of the cobwebs that had just formed around her brain. "Yeah," she says quickly. "Yeah, just... yeah. Thinking about mom and dad." You presume that they were good memories, going by the look on her face. She shifts a bit, causing her massive tail to flex and pull you as she does. "You'll be surprised to hear, [pc.name], that I didn't have a whole lot of friends growing up," she says instead. "I got bullied a lot for my... biology. I'm not quite a veparus, but I'm not quite a pexighast, either. Some kids can be real assholes, you know." "But mom and dad?" she continues. "They – they never made me feel like I was a freak. They made me feel like I was their daughter. I'd usually come home crying because the other kids, on a good day, they'd tease me, they'd point, they'd laugh. On a bad day, they'd pick on me, push me, get physical. They'd–" She suddenly snaps her mouth shut, her eyes widening just slightly. "Actually, I should end that train of thought," she says. But her expression softens back to what it was. "Point is, I'd usually come home crying and sniffling. And mom and dad, they'd hug me. They'd tell me that they loved me. Mom would sing to me and she'd read me books. Dad, he'd let me help out around the house to get my mind off things." Her grin spreads again, widely enough that one of her fangs glints in the light of the candle. "And he'd teach me how to defend myself from bullies. Mom would always tell me to go find an adult. Dad would always tell me to go for the teeth." Raizel leans towards the shelf again, resting her elbow on it, and her chin on her upturned hand. Her gaze continues to roam the room, going everywhere but your own eyes. "You'd think that parents have to do that sappy shit for their kid. It's their kid, right? How fucked up do you have to be to treat your own kid wrong?" She blinks, hard. You think you see something else glinting in the light of the candle before it's wicked away by her own eyelid. "But it never felt that way with them. They didn't just say that they loved me; they made sure that I felt it." She pauses, then swallows, sniffles, brings her free hand to her nose, then rubs at her eyes with her thumb and index finger. She leans back again, and when she opens her eyes, she focuses on you once more. Her posture and expression reset, as if you two had only just started talking. "Been chasing that dragon ever since," she finishes. You tell Raizel that her parents were good people. "They sure as shit were," she agrees. "Not a day goes by that I don't miss them." Slowly, the mirth and joy from her face deflates, and her eyes narrow back into something harder. "Not a day goes by," she continues, "that I..." You sit there[pc.isDK |, in part because she has you good and trapped ], waiting for her to finish the thought, if she even is. "That I," she tries again. Her jaw shuts. She takes a sigh through her nose. "I wonder if they'd be proud of me." [pc.isDK |You believe her when she says that her parents genuinely loved her. But, the truth is, ‘love' is different from ‘pride'. "Yeah," she agrees. "You get it. |Of course they would be. If they loved her as much as she says they did– "‘Love' is different from ‘pride', [pc.name]," Raizel interrupts. " ]If they were alive and they saw me now, they'd have seen that their little girl had grown up to be some scrounging, worthless dreg of a woman, eating rats off the streets and jumping strangers in caves to try and get by. That's who they raised. If I were Mom, I wouldn't be proud of that." Raizel looks down, turning her hand over and staring into her own palm. "Shit, I'm not proud of that. I feel like I'm disrespecting them." She closes her hand into a fist – one that's not particularly tight, but her hand shakes with repressed energy anyway. "They raised me to do my best, and this is the best I got to give." She sighs, wistful, defeated, reminiscent, and exhausted, all at once. She leans back, sagging her shoulders as she rests against the far wall. Her eyes drift off to the side, once again staring at nothing. "The thought that gets me through some days," she says quietly, "is that... I like to think that they'd be proud of me for making it this far, despite everything. Which... feels... backhanded. ‘Congrats on living, Raizel. You haven't done fuck all with your life but take up someone else's oxygen, but hey, you didn't die.'" ... If she's not proud of who she is, and she worries that her parents wouldn't be proud of the daughter that she raised... then she ought to do something about them. It's not too late to turn herself into a woman she knows her parents would be prideful of. Raizel lets out another sigh, this time through her mouth, and this time, it grinds against the inside of her throat in frustration. "It's that simple, is it?" she says, her gaze still askew. "Just strap on some boots and go make myself into something?" She turns her head towards you. The familiar, scowling expression you've known her for has returned, with her burning red eyes boring down into you from above. The glint of her teeth – and the tears in her eyes – have vanished. "Not every bully, asshole kid grows up to be the kind of person that recognizes that, sometimes, people are different," she says. "You let me know when there's room in the world for someone like me, [pc.name]." ] '

rows.original:
You approach the statue of the bovine headsman, drawing forth your waystone charm and holding it up towards her lantern and the gem suspended within. The moment you hold up your own charm, you feel a tension rising in the air, and the atmosphere crackles with power. You grit your teeth and step forward, forcing yourself towards the ancient idol.

        And then, suddenly the pressure breaks, and an unnatural howl echoes through the abandoned caravanserai. The gemstone in the statue's lantern shines and begins to pulse with inner light... it's awake! You grin and close your fist around the charm, watching as the light settles, illuminating the chamber. The idol is awakened once more...
rows.translation:
你走向那个牛头人的雕像，取出自己的路石护符，将其举向她的灯笼以及悬挂在其中的宝石。就在你举起护身符的那一刻，你感觉到空气中弥漫着一种紧张的气氛，整个空间仿佛都被力量所充斥，充满了电轻型火石般的能量。 你咬紧牙关，向前走去，强迫自己朝着那座古老的雕像走去。

就在这时，突然间，那种压迫感消失了，一道不自然的嚎叫声在废弃的商队旅馆中回荡。雕像灯笼中的宝石开始发轻型，内部仿佛有轻型在跳动。…它醒来了！你露出微笑，将那枚护身符握在拳头中，注视着轻型芒逐渐凝聚，照亮了整个房间。那个神像又一次被唤醒了……

He gestures at the city, pointing a few of the gigantic structures out. "Some of them lead directly under the colosseum itself, so we can pump water up into the lower level and flood it. Then we float the boats out from storage chambers." [pc.dcb|"Are you making fun of me?" you ask, squinting.|"You're not just making this up, are you?" you ask, smiling.|"Aww, you're totally making this up!" you say, pouting.] "I'm not!" he says, laughing harder. "Aaah, forget it. I'll just show you when we go there. You'll see." |"It's pretty impressive, right?" Brienne says, nudging you. She points to the colosseum. "You should see the naval battles in there. You can spend your whole day watching what goes on." "Wait, naval battles?" you ask, baffled. [pc.isBimbo|"Like, how is that even possible?"|"How?"] She laughs. "There's a massive sewer system beneath the city. You see some of these aqueducts?" She gestures at the city, pointing a few of the gigantic structures out. "Some of them lead directly under the colosseum itself, so we can pump water up into the lower level and flood it. Then we float the boats out from storage chambers." [pc.dcb|"Are you making fun of me?" you ask, squinting.|"You're not just making this up, are you?" you ask, smiling.|"Aww, you're totally making this up!" you say, pouting.] "I promise I'm not!" she says, trying not to smile. "Aw, forget it. I'll just show you when we go there. You'll see."|You've heard some truly fantastical things about the battles inside, some of which surely aren't true. The wars and animal fights are one thing, but the story about the boats and naval combat are something else altogether. Drunken delusions, surely. ] Further inspection reveals a large — though nowhere near the same scale as the Colosseum — building that can only be the Pantheon, where worshippers attend to pray for divine favor. Divided into seven sections, you suppose each one must be for a specific god. "Incredible," you mutter, gazing down at the city. It looks like you'll have to pass through the surrounding residential outskirts before you can hope to access the city proper. Pulling back from the view, you ready yourself for the next leg of your journey. ]'

rows.original: Raizel isn't feeling well, but, fortunately, it's not too serious. She'll need more than just some fresh water, but it's a good start.
rows.translation: 莱泽尔感觉不太舒服，不过幸运的是，情况并不严重。她需要的不仅仅是新鲜的水，但这已经是一个好的开始。
rows.raw: "Raizel isn't feeling well, but, fortunately, it's not too serious. She'll need more than just some fresh water, but it's a good start."

rows.original: Raizel isn't feeling well, but, fortunately, it's not too serious. She'll need more than just some fresh water, but it's a good start.
rows.translation: 莱泽尔感觉不太舒服，不过幸运的是，情况并不严重。她需要的不仅仅是新鲜的水，但这已经是一个好的开始。
rows.raw: "Raizel isn't feeling well, but, fortunately, it's not too serious. She'll need more than just some fresh water, but it's a good start."

rows.original: The snake-hybrid woman Raizel calls this dilapidated, run-down, unwelcoming stretch of road her home. You could pay her a visit, [raizel.affectionRange 0 6 21 41|though who's to say if she's in a welcoming sort of mood right now...|and who knows? She might actually enjoy your company this time.|and given your rapport with her lately, you get the impression that she's hoping you will.|and with how she's been acting around you lately, visiting her would really brighten her day.]
rows.translation: 这位拥有蛇族血统的女性莱泽尔，将这条破败不堪、令人不适的道路称为自己的家。你完全可以去拜访她一番。 [raizel.affectionRange 0 6 21 41|不过，谁又能说她现在是不是处于一种欢迎他人的心情呢……|谁知道呢？也许这次她真的会喜欢和你在一起。|而且考虑到你最近与她的关系，你会觉得她其实希望你会这么做的。|考虑到她最近在你身边的表现，去拜访她肯定会让她开心很多。]
rows.raw: "The snake-hybrid woman Raizel calls this dilapidated, run-down, unwelcoming stretch of road her home. You could pay her a visit, [raizel.affectionRange 0 6 21 41|though who's to say if she's in a welcoming sort of mood right now...|and who knows? She might actually enjoy your company this time.|and given your rapport with her lately, you get the impression that she's hoping you will.|and with how she's been acting around you lately, visiting her would really brighten her day.]"

rows.original: It can not be seen, whenever it's there Filling up a room, much like air In its absence, there is safety The more there is, the less you see.
rows.translation: 它无形无色，却无处不在； 它充满整个空间，就如同空气一般； 没有它的存在，反而会让人感到安全； 然而，当它的存在过于浓烈时，人们反而看不清它了。
rows.raw: "It can not be seen, whenever it's there Filling up a room, much like air In its absence, there is safety The more there is, the less you see."

rows.original: With a satisfying click, the chest's mechanism unlocks. You anxiously raise the ornate top and look inside. [party.has brint brienne |"Nice. This'll come in handy," [brint.name] says as you pull out a lantern. "Oil lanterns like that are really hard to come by, I've only ever heard of nobles and statesmen being able to get their hands on them. Makes going through these tunnels a hell of a lot more convenient." |Inside you find the fanciest lantern you've ever laid eyes on. There are knobs and mechanisms all over it, and you can smell a hint of the oil vapors it uses as fuel wafting through the air. ] A little twist here, a little squeeze there, and in a flash of light the lantern comes to life. You can see further in the darkness of the Undermountain.
rows.translation: 随着一声令人满意的咔嗒声，箱子的机关被解开了。你迫不及待地掀开那华丽的盖子，向里面望去。 [party.has brint brienne |不错，这个会派上用场的。 [brint.name] 你掏出灯笼说道：“这样的油灯实在很难找，我只听说过贵族和政客才能拥有这样的东西。有了它，穿过这些隧道就方便多了。 |里面有你见过的最精美的灯笼。它的表面布满了各种旋钮和机械装置，空气中还弥漫着那种作为燃料的油蒸气的淡淡气味。 ] 稍加调整，稍加按压，转眼间，这个灯笼就活了过来。 在幽暗的地下山脉中，你可以看到更远的地方。
rows.raw: " With a satisfying click, the chest's mechanism unlocks. You anxiously raise the ornate top and look inside. [party.has brint brienne |"Nice. You can see further in the darkness of the Undermountain."

rows.original: Several cubbyholes branch off from the main tunnel here, and as you pass by you spy an abandoned camp in one of them. It's clearly been abandoned in a hurry — whoever was here didn't manage to collect everything in their retreat — and the tattered remnants of two crude sleeping mats lie by the side of a makeshift firepit. On impulse, you search the camp, hoping to find something of use. [var0 |It only takes a couple of minutes, but you're able to find something that rolled under one of the mats and has lain hidden for only the gods know how long. You found [var1]! |After a couple of minutes, you're forced to admit that this has been a waste of time. Still, it didn't take long — nothing ventured, nothing gained. ]
rows.translation: 在这里，主隧道分出了几条小岔道，当你经过其中一条时，发现其中一个岔道里有一个被废弃的营地。显然，这里的人是匆忙离开的——他们没能带走所有的东西——破旧的睡垫残片就扔在临时搭建的火堆旁边。 你一时冲动，决定搜查这个营地，希望能找到一些有用的东西。 [var0 |只需要几分钟的时间，你就能找到那些被卷到垫子下面、隐藏了不知多久的物品。 你找到了。 [var1]! |几分钟后，你不得不承认，这纯粹是在浪费时间。不过，其实也没花太长时间——既没有付出任何努力，也没有获得任何成果。 ]
rows.raw: " Several cubbyholes branch off from the main tunnel here, and as you pass by you spy an abandoned camp in one of them. It's clearly been abandoned in a hurry — whoever was here didn't manage to collect everything in their retreat — and the tattered remnants of two crude sleeping mats lie by the side of a makeshift firepit. On impulse, you search the camp, hoping to find something of use. [var0 |It only takes a couple of minutes, but you're able to find something that rolled under one of the mats and has lain hidden for only the gods know how long. You found [var1]! |After a couple of minutes, you're forced to admit that this has been a waste of time. Still, it didn't take long — nothing ventured, nothing gained. ]"

rows.original: As you turn through the twisting tunnels, you pass by several of the partially collapsed tunnels that the minotaurs used to slow the demons' advance, now blocked by huge heaps of rubble. Making your way around, you feel a sudden tremor run through the caverns — and now chunks of debris are rolling down from the piles of collapsed rock and right towards you!
rows.translation: 当你穿梭在那些蜿蜒曲折的隧道中时，会经过几处部分坍塌的隧道——那些弥诺陶洛斯曾经利用这些隧道来延缓恶魔的前进速度，如今这些隧道已被巨大的碎石堆完全堵塞。在绕过这些障碍物继续前进时，你突然感觉到整个洞穴开始剧烈震动，紧接着，大量碎石从那些坍塌的岩石堆中滚落下来，直接朝你的方向袭来！
rows.raw: "\n    As you turn through the twisting tunnels, you pass by several of the partially collapsed tunnels that the minotaurs used to slow the demons' advance, now blocked by huge heaps of rubble. Making your way around, you feel a sudden tremor run through the caverns — and now chunks of debris are rolling down from the piles of collapsed rock and right towards you!"

rows.original: You book it as hard as you can, running back the way you came.
rows.translation: 你用尽全力奔跑，沿着来时的路往回赶去。
rows.raw: "You book it as hard as you can, running back the way you came."

rows.original:

        [var0
            |A moment later and you're running for an alcove in the tunnel wall that you can hide in while the rolling debris passes you by.             |You spend just a little too long looking for shelter: by the time you realize there's none to be found, it's too late to run completely out of the way: you end up slammed into the ground by stone, pelted black and blue by debris!
        ]

你迅速环顾四周，试图找到一个可以躲藏的地方！

rows.translation: [target.CombatName] 运行[tps|s] 尽快完成，但最终还是要达到目标。[tps|s] 被一阵石子砸中了！
rows.raw: "\n                [target.CombatName] run[tps|s] as fast as possible, but still end[tps|s] up pelted by a hail of stones!"

rows.original: Use a little quick thinking to find somewhere safe to hide!
rows.translation: 迅速动脑筋，找个安全的地方躲起来吧！
rows.raw: "Use a little quick thinking to find somewhere safe to hide!"

rows.original: Put your magic to use and create an arcane barrier against the landslide!
rows.translation: 运用你的魔法，构筑一道神秘屏障，阻止山体滑坡的发生吧！
rows.raw: "Put your magic to use and create an arcane barrier against the landslide!"

rows.original: If only you were more gifted in the arcane!
rows.translation: 要是你能在神秘力量方面更有天赋该多好啊！
rows.raw: "If only you were more gifted in the arcane!"

rows.original: Walking through the tunnels of the undermountain, you come across a large rock face that's been partially excavated, mushroom-wood scaffolding lying against the side of the small cavern. Looks like some prospecting was going on before this whole business with the demons and general unrest in the tunnels brought it to a close, and no one's been back since what with the quarantine and all. Several veins of minerals are exposed — not exactly a fortune, but nothing to sneeze at, either. While you don't have the time or wherewithal to perform an actual excavation and extraction, you could nevertheless gather something from the most promising outcroppings [var0 |with the aid of the pickaxe you pilfered off that demon, if you're willing to expend the effort |if you're willing to expend some camping supplies to serve as makeshift mining tools ]. Are you?
rows.translation: 当你穿过山底下的隧道时，会遇到一处被部分挖掘出来的巨大岩壁，一些蘑菇木搭建的脚手架靠在那个小洞穴的侧壁上。看来在恶魔入侵以及隧道里发生的一系列动荡之前，这里曾经进行过勘探工作，但由于那些原因，勘探工作被迫中断了，而且由于隔离措施等原因，此后也没有人再回到这里。 有几处矿脉已经裸露出来——虽然算不上巨额财富，但也不算少。虽然你没有时间或条件进行真正的挖掘和开采，不过还是可以从那些最有希望找到矿物的地方采集一些样本吧。 [var0 |如果你愿意花些功夫的话，利用那把镐头，你就能把那个恶魔的东西偷过来。 |如果你愿意花一些精力或资源的话…… 露营用品 被临时用作采矿工具 ]是吗？
rows.raw: " Walking through the tunnels of the undermountain, you come across a large rock face that's been partially excavated, mushroom-wood scaffolding lying against the side of the small cavern. Looks like some prospecting was going on before this whole business with the demons and general unrest in the tunnels brought it to a close, and no one's been back since what with the quarantine and all. Several veins of minerals are exposed — not exactly a fortune, but nothing to sneeze at, either. While you don't have the time or wherewithal to perform an actual excavation and extraction, you could nevertheless gather something from the most promising outcroppings [var0 |with the aid of the pickaxe you pilfered off that demon, if you're willing to expend the effort |if you're willing to expend some camping supplies to serve as makeshift mining tools ]. Are you?"

rows.original: [var1 |It's no small amount of effort, but the masterwork tool makes it a far simpler affair than otherwise. The glimmering iron chips away at the rock with uncanny efficiency, though you have to work carefully to avoid unsettling the wall. With more time and some additional equipment, you could doubtless accomplish a full excavation, but as it is, by the time your arms tire, you've gathered the majority of the obvious veins. Not a bad job at all! A little soreness is a fair price to pay, you muse as you stuff your freshly-acquired yield into your pack alongside your trusty pickaxe, before departing the scene. |It's a bit crude, but you lay out your camping tools and set to work, reinforcing scaffolding with rope and using tent pegs as chisels to go with the mallets. It takes some time and you wear out the camping supplies in the process, but after an hour or so you manage to extract the choicest bits of minerals to be had. There's still plenty to be prospected, but all of the low-hanging fruit is safely in your possession at the end of it all. Tossing away the now-useless camping supplies, you depart the scene. ] You obtain [var0].
rows.translation: [var1 |这确实需要付出相当大的努力，但有了这个高效的工具，整个过程就变得简单多了。那些闪烁的铁屑能够以惊人的效率侵蚀岩石，不过你还是必须小心操作，以免破坏墙壁的结构。 如果有更多的时间以及一些额外的工具，你肯定能够完成一次彻底的挖掘工作。但实际情况是，当你的手臂开始感到疲劳时，你已经收集到了大部分显而易见的矿脉。这样的成果已经相当不错了！你想着，稍微有些酸痛也是值得的。于是，你把刚刚采集到的矿石连同那把可靠的镐一起装进背包，然后离开了现场。 |这种方法虽然有些粗糙，但你需要先将所有的露营工具准备好，然后开始工作——用绳子加固脚手架，把帐篷钉当作凿子来使用，再配合锤子进行作业。这个过程需要花费一些时间，而且也会消耗掉不少露营用品，但大约一个小时后，你终于能够提取到那些最优质的矿物。虽然还有许多地方可以继续勘探，但所有那些容易获取的资源，在这个过程结束时都已经安全地落入了你的手中。把那些已经不再有用的露营用品扔掉，你便离开了现场。 ] 你获得了 [var0].

Not a bad job at all! A little soreness is a fair price to pay, you muse as you stuff your freshly-acquired yield into your pack alongside your trusty pickaxe, before departing the scene. |It's a bit crude, but you lay out your camping tools and set to work, reinforcing scaffolding with rope and using tent pegs as chisels to go with the mallets. It takes some time and you wear out the camping supplies in the process, but after an hour or so you manage to extract the choicest bits of minerals to be had. There's still plenty to be prospected, but all of the low-hanging fruit is safely in your possession at the end of it all. Tossing away the now-useless camping supplies, you depart the scene. ] You obtain [var0]."

rows.original: You don't have any camping supplies on you.
rows.translation: 你身上没有任何露营用品。
rows.raw: "You don't have any camping supplies on you."

rows.original: Either you don't have the camping supplies necessary, or you need them for more important things — like actually being able to get some reasonably safe rest in a dangerous locale like this. One way or the other, the temptation of mineral wealth has no hold on you, and you're on your way.
rows.translation: 要么是你没有必要的露营用品，要么是你需要把这些用品用来处理更重要的事情——比如在这种危险的环境中，能够找到一个相对安全的地方休息。无论如何，那些矿产财富的诱惑都无法吸引你，你依然坚持着自己的路线前进。
rows.raw: "\n        Either you don't have the camping supplies necessary, or you need them for more important things — like actually being able to get some reasonably safe rest in a dangerous locale like this. One way or the other, the temptation of mineral wealth has no hold on you, and you're on your way."

rows.original:
As you pass through the tunnels, you hear heavy footfalls coming your way, followed by the light of several torches — as it turns out, it's a patrol of a dozen minotaur legionnaires. Seeing you, they stand at attention and salute.

    "Well met, champion!"
    
    You squint. Khor'minos has no end of willing minotaurs raring to join the legion, especially in these trying times, and you're pretty sure you've never seen these particular bulls before. Then again, it's not surprising that just about every legionnaire would know your face given the shenanigans that you've pulled off with Calise in tow.
    
    You tell the minotaurs to be at ease, then ask them if their patrol has been eventful.
    
    "Not much more than a few imps, [pc.mf
        |sir
        |ma'am
    ]," their leader grunts. "Things have been a lot better in the tunnels of late, thanks to Lady Calise and you. They aren't coming in the swarms that they used to, so we're able to control the imps with smaller patrols like these that let us cover more ground. We're out on general patrol for a few days, so we're just roaming all over. Won't say it's peaceful, but there's strength in numbers as well. Dissuades the imps and other riff-raff."
    
    Strength in numbers, huh? That gives you an idea. There's an opportunity here — traveling through the tunnels with a squad of minotaurs at your back would certainly expedite your journey. It'd cost, of course, but what in this world doesn't?
rows.translation:
当你穿过隧道时，听到有重型的脚步声朝你走来，紧接着几支火把的轻型芒也出现了——原来是一支由十几名弥诺陶洛斯军团士兵组成的巡逻队。看到你后，他们立刻立正行礼。

    很高兴见到你，冠军！”

你眯了眯眼睛。在这样的艰难时期，科尔米诺斯总有无数自愿加入军团的弥诺陶洛斯，而你很确定自己以前从未见过这些特定的公牛。不过，考虑到你和卡莉丝一起搞过那些闹剧，几乎每个军团成员都应该认识你的脸，所以这也并不奇怪。
    
    你让米诺陶洛们放松下来，然后询问他们的巡逻是否有什么特别的事情发生。

“也就遇到了一些小妖精而已…… [pc.mf
        |先生
        |女士
    ]事情最近在隧道里变得好多了，这都要归功于卡莉丝女士和你。”他们的领袖低声说道，“那些怪物不再像以前那样成群结队地来了，所以我们只需要派出规模较小的巡逻队就能控制那些小怪物，这样我们就能覆盖更广的区域了。 我们这几天正在进行常规巡逻，所以一直在四处游荡。虽然不能说环境很安宁，但人多总是有优势的——至少能吓退那些小妖精和其他捣乱分子。

人多就是力量，是吧？这样你就明白我的意思了。 这里有一个机会——如果有着一群弥诺陶洛斯跟随在你身后，陪你一起穿过这些隧道，那么你的旅程肯定会变得更加迅速。当然，这也会需要付出一定的代价，但在这个世界上，有什么事情是不需要付出代价的呢？

rows.original: You give the squad of legionnaires a nod, and they salute once more before marching off into the tunnels. Even if the city is still under quarantine, there're still people out here in the tunnels, so making the Undermountain safer for everyone is still a merit for what it's worth.
rows.translation: 你向那支军团士兵们点了点头，他们再次行礼，然后便踏入了隧道中。尽管这座城市仍处于隔离状态，但隧道里仍然有人活动，因此让山腹深域变得更加安全，对所有人来说都是一件有意义的事。

Even if the city is still under quarantine, there're still people out here in the tunnels, so making the Undermountain safer for everyone is still a merit for what it's worth."

rows.original: Dismiss the minotaurs and be on your way.
rows.translation: 赶走那些弥诺陶洛斯，然后继续你的路吧。
rows.raw: "Dismiss the minotaurs and be on your way."

rows.original: The legionnaires huddle together at your proposal, trying to be discreet and failing comically at it in the way only a bunch of hulking bull-men can. "Well, if we don't tell the centurion, who'll know?" "I was pissed he didn't want to come out on patrol with us, but maybe it turned out for the better, after all..." "It's going to be fine, we don't have a strict patrol route, after all. Not like we're expected back for a few days, anyway." "It is the champion of the elves, isn't it? [pc.HeShe] is working under Lady Calise, [pc.heShe] has the right to commandeer us is [pc.heShe] sees fit. It's all very by-the-book, no one can say we're breaking any rules." "I don't know about you, but I'd like some spending money to throw at the colosseum when we're off-duty... have you seen ticket prices lately?" Done with their discussion, the legionnaires turn to you and salute. "We'd be happy to escort you anywhere you like within the undermountain, champion. Together, we'll put the fear of the gods in the demons — that way they won't come out of their holes for a good long while!" You chuckle. People really do have a way of justifying what they really want to do to themselves, but hey, it's working in your favor. You hand the money over to the minotaur legionnaires, and they fall into step around you[party.hasCompanions |r party ]. Now, where would you like them to take you?
rows.translation: 那些士兵们聚在一起讨论你的提议，他们试图保持低调，但以他们那些魁梧大汉特有的方式，这种尝试显得十分滑稽可笑。 “嗯，如果我们不告诉百夫长，还会有人知道吗？” “他不愿意和我们一起出去巡逻，当时我真的很生气，但也许这样反而是件好事……” “应该不会有问题的，毕竟我们的巡逻路线并不固定。而且反正也不会有人指望我们几天内就回来吧。 是 精灵们的冠军，不是吗？ [pc.HeShe] 是 在卡莉丝女士的领导下工作， [pc.heShe] 有权征用我们 [pc.heShe] 他们认为这样做是合适的。一切都是按照规定来进行的，没有人能说我们违反了任何规则。” “我不知道你们怎么想，但…… 我会。 就像我们下班后愿意花钱去竞技场看表演一样……你最近看看门票价格就知道了吧。” 讨论结束后，这些军团士兵转向你，行礼道：“冠军，我们很乐意陪您去地下城的任何地方。只要我们齐心协力，就能让那些恶魔胆寒到不敢再出来冒头了！” 你笑了笑。人们果然总有办法为自己想要做的事情找到合理的理由…… 真的 他们本来想对自己做出什么不好的事情，但嘿，结果却对你有利。你把钱交给了弥诺陶洛斯军团的成员们，于是他们就开始听你的指挥了。[party.hasCompanions |派对 ]那么，你希望它们带你去哪里呢？

rows.original:
"This way, champion."

            The legionnaires don't make any effort to hide their presence — if anything, they're louder with you in their midst than when you first noticed them approaching. It works, though: with the earth-shaking racket they're making with all their stomping around, you don't spy so much as a shadow on your way to your destination. Walking for several hours through the tunnels is boring, but boring is better than being waylaid, and be it by expediency or knowledge of their home turf they do get you to your destination faster than you'd have otherwise.
            
            "Here we are." As one, the minotaurs salute. "Pleasure being able to patrol with you, champion — it's good for morale to know that the brass are willing to accompany us even on simple patrols like these."
            
            Sure, sure. You watch the legionnaires tromp away into the distance, and return your attention to your surroundings...
rows.translation:
这边走，冠军。”

这些军团士兵丝毫没有试图隐藏自己的存在——事实上，当你他们就在你身边时，他们发出的声响甚至比你最初注意到他们靠近时还要大。不过，这种做法确实有效：由于他们四处跺脚所发出的震天响声，你在前往目的地的路上根本无法看到任何影子。 在隧道中行走数小时确实很无聊，但无聊总比被耽搁要好。无论是出于效率考虑，还是因为他们对这片地形的熟悉，他们总能让你比原本预期的更快到达目的地。
            
            我们到了。”弥诺陶洛斯们齐声敬礼。“能与您一起执行巡逻任务，真是太荣幸了，冠军——知道上层领导甚至愿意陪我们参加这样的简单巡逻，确实能让我们的士气大大提升。”

rows.original: You're walking through the tunnels when you spy some supplies left behind. No telling if it was a group of Khor'minoan soldiers, unlucky adventurers, or even demons. But you do see [var0] among the scattered kit. Since they're around, you might as well take some to help you on your way.
rows.translation: 当你正在穿过这些隧道时，突然发现了一些被遗弃的物资。不知道这些物资是哪一群科尔米诺亚士兵留下的，还是那些不幸的冒险者留下的，又或者是恶魔的东西。但无论如何，你确实看到了这些物资。 [var0] 在那些散落的物品中…… 既然它们就在附近，你不妨拿一些来帮助自己完成任务吧。
rows.raw: " You're walking through the tunnels when you spy some supplies left behind. No telling if it was a group of Khor'minoan soldiers, unlucky adventurers, or even demons. But you do see [var0] among the scattered kit. Since they're around, you might as well take some to help you on your way."

rows.original: The sound your [pc.footwear] makes against the pavement is the only thing you hear, and it's been that way for a while already. In front of you, the dim-lighted tunnel shows the same gray scene you've already left behind a couple of times: vandalized statues, lonely beams supporting the low ceiling and abandoned crates, not important enough for their owners to come back for. But there's something amiss this time, something you can't quite tell... A gust of wind announces that your time for thinking has reached an end. You quickly take a step to the side and see how a warhammer comes crashing down, obliterating the air where your head had been, and stopping only when the metal finds the ground. It frees a cloud of dust, where you can see the silhouette of a demon wearing heavy armor, taking the hammer onto her pauldron. "Well, well," Sandre says as the brown mist settles. "If it isn't our favorite entertainment around these caves. I knew you could dodge that." [pc.dcb|"Few people have tried an attack like that and left unscathed," you say while reaching for your [pc.weapon]|And thank god you did. The woman wasn't holding back.|"Watch ouuut," you say with a frown while stomping the ground. "That could've hurt me."] "You should have waited, Sandre," Caera says with a sigh. She approaches you without a rush, only with her graceful steps and unmoving expression. "A spell would have been more effective." "Maybe next time. Now it's time to play, right Champ? I've been saving up some big load to fill your guts, so you better get that ass ready." Sandre jumps towards you with her warhammer. Meanwhile Caera rolls her eyes with resignation and produces her wand and dagger. It's a fight.
rows.translation: 你发出的声音…… [pc.footwear] 你能听到的只有车轮与路面的摩擦声，而且这种声音已经持续了好一段时间。在你面前，昏暗的隧道中展现的景象与你之前几次经过时看到的完全一样：被破坏的雕像、支撑着低矮天花板的孤零零的梁柱，以及那些被遗弃的箱子——对于它们的主人来说，这些东西显然不值得他们再回来取。 但这一次，有些事情不对劲，有些事情你一时难以察觉…… 一阵风吹来，宣告你思考的时间已经结束。你迅速向旁边闪避，只见一把战锤重重坠落，正好砸在你刚才所在的位置，金属撞击地面的声音响起，战锤才终于停了下来。 一阵尘土飞扬，随后你可以看到一个穿着厚重盔甲的恶魔的轮廓，她将那把锤子举到了自己的护肩上。 “哎呀，真是太棒了，”当棕色的尘雾渐渐散去时，桑德雷说道，“这不是我们在这片洞穴里最喜欢的娱乐活动吗？ 我就知道你能躲开那个的。 [pc.dcb|很少有人尝试过那样的攻击却能毫发无损地逃脱，”你边说边伸手去拿…… [pc.weapon]|谢天谢地，你这么做了。那个女人可一点都没有留手。|当心啊，”你皱着眉头说道，同时重重地踩在地板上，“那东西可能会伤到我的。] 你本应该再等等的，桑德雷，”凯拉叹息着说道。她没有急着靠近你，只是迈着优雅的步伐，面无表情地走向你，“使用咒语会更有效一些。” “也许下次吧。现在该开始游戏了，对吧，冠军？我可是准备了一些很厉害的招式来让你大吃一惊的，所以你最好做好准备。” 桑德雷手持战锤朝你冲了过来。而凯拉则无奈地翻了个白眼，取出了她的魔杖和匕首。 这是一场战斗。

rows.original: A dark blanket of shadows covers everything. It's so thick that your own hands are swallowed up by the nothingness the instant you extend your arm to try to search for the wall... just as if there was actually something hiding from sight, making sure the veil of darkness is not unraveled no matter how hard you try. [party.hasCompanions|[companion1.isMage|"This...this must be some kind of magic," [companion1.name] says.]|[pc.cl whitemage blackmage|"This...this is some kind of magic," you say to yourself.|"What is this?" you tell yourself.]] The echo of two pairs of footsteps break the silence. They're approaching you, and the clanking sound tells you they're wearing armor. "Finally. I was starting to think there was nothing fun under this damned mountain," someone says as the noises come to a halt. "Break the spell, Caera, let's see what we've found." A feeble spark of light tears through the black curtain, revealing the hand of someone whose delicate index finger holds the flame like the erected wax of a candle. The fire grows, and you can see the woman behind the spell, who you suppose is Caera. She's of blue skin, with a beautiful face, delicate and unmoving, as if it were an angel's visage carved into apatite stone. Her static expression is framed by white, straight hair that hides her forehead with flat bangs. Then you spot the horns, black as coal, and realize that her eyes are of the same color, but with a drop of gold shining in the iris. She's a demon. And she's not alone. Another demon comes into view, this one is a woman of skin red like blood and dark hair with indigo shades, like the sea at night. She wears black, heavy armor and a warhammer that she lifts from the ground and takes onto her pauldron without even flinching. "What do you think?" the red demon asks. "[party.hasCompanions|They seem|[pc.heShe] seems] good enough," Caera says, eyeing you up. "I wonder if [party.hasCompanions|they|[pc.heShe]]'ll live up to our expectations." "It's not like opening the yap and taking my cock is that hard." "Okay, my expectations then, Sandre. My cunt is a little harder to please." "Wanna bet on who cums first?" Sandre says with a grin.                 |"Yes, I am serious,"
                |"Would it be that much of an issue?"
                |"Is that okay? I just don't want people to get scared. I mean, you're demons after all,"
            ] you say.
            
            "It's just... there's a reason I don't look that way anymore," Caera says, and her unmoving expression seems to flicker. "I like who I am now."
            
            "Hey, it's okay, " Sandre says, gently caressing her girl's shoulder. "Looking one way or another doesn't change who we are beneath. And it can be fun, who knows."
            
            "Yeah. I-I don't really have a problem. It's fine," Caera says with a shrug she then breathes in deeply. "You got it Champ, we'll look a little bit less demonlike." 
            
            "Now if you don't mind..." Sandre says, circling her finger in the air to tell you to turn your back to them. 
            
            You comply with a sigh and hear how they move and whisper behind you. Meanwhile, you can't help but wonder how the couple used to look before turning into the demons that you know. The answer doesn't take too long to arrive. 
            
            "Okay, what do you think, Champ?" Sandre says.
            
            When you turn around you see a bulky girl. She has the same dark mane, but her skin has a light tan instead of her usual red. The dark sclera has turned white, and the golden drop that was her iris is now vivid blue. 
            
            She averts her gaze and twitches her nose; it's small and round, and a scar on her septum tells you that she had already been in fights long before losing her soul. Still, even with those marks, her face looks all too pretty for her rudish nature.
            
            "You better have some nice words of praise prepared. After making us do all this, that's the least you can do," Caera says. Her eyes are hazel, and her features soft. Dark lips garnish her small mouth, working well with her light tan, and making a beautiful contrast with the ivory hair that reaches her chest. 
            
            "I do have some nice words for you if you want them, gorgeous," Sandre says, as she winks and pulls Caera closer.
            
            Then you spot the tail behind Caera. Everything about the girl seems human, but she's decided to keep the black tail coiling around her leg.
            
            "Let me keep that at least," she pleads when she notices your gaze.
            
            "Fine," you concede. 
            
            She does look human enough, after all. Even if you know they're clearly not.
